monsters.name: Skyfeather Folk
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A winged people who originated on the Elemental Plane of Air, aarakocra soar through the sky wherever they wander. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Desert Vulturefolk
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Native to the harsh world of Athas, these bird-people resemble lanky, disheveled vultures with black eyes, gray beaks, and fragile bones. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Star-Shaped Rootbeast
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Nomadic, sapient vegetables shaped like a five-pointed star made of corded, bark-like tree roots. Abilities: alien anatomy, eldritch horror, unsettling movement, psychic aura, cosmic horror

monsters.name: Celestial Kin
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Humanoids "descended from ethereal beings"[106] from the Outer Planes, "charming creatures protecting the universe against evil". Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Luminous Arbiter
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Celestials from the Outer Planes, "charming creatures protecting the universe against evil". Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Opalescent Vanguard
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. The elite vanguard of the celestial armies, appearing in their natural form as beautiful elves with opalescent, luminous skin and shining eyes. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Divine Winged Messenger
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Stunningly handsome winged humanoids who serve as messengers and warriors of the Upper Planes, including the golden-hued Astral Devas, the green-eyed Monadic Devas of the Elemental Planes, and the silvery Movanic Devas. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Prismatic Mist Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Energy creatures appearing as swirling mists of shifting light and rainbow colors, often serving as familiars or companions to high-level, good-aligned worshipers. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Emerald Guardian General
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Powerful celestial spirits that serve as generals of the celestial host, appearing as tall humanoids with emerald skin, white wings, and wielding massive two-handed vorpal swords. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Radiant Solar Seraph
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Very powerful winged angelic humanoids. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Living Liquid Ooze
monsters.description: Type: Ooze. Also known as "Living Water," these dangerous oozes are indistinguishable from clear puddles of fresh water in their passive state but are composed of a weak acid that drowns and dissolves victims. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Hive-Minded Insectoid
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Described are the Vassal, Soldier, and Queen. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Draconic Infernal
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Described are the white, black, green, blue and red abishai, baatezu subraces. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Defensive Spellbinder
monsters.description: Type: Creature. An Abjurer is a wizard specializing in the School of Abjuration, focusing on defensive magic and protection. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Psionic Abyssal Fish
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Slime-Skin Thrall
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Human aberrations with translucent and slimy skin. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Mind-Bending Deepdweller
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A variant of the standard aboleth that has refined its mind to the point of replacing traditional magic with raw, overwhelming psionic power. Abilities: alien anatomy, eldritch horror, unsettling movement, psychic aura, cosmic horror

monsters.name: Elder Arcane Lurker
monsters.description: Type: Creature. The ruling elite of aboleth cities, Savants are rare wizard-priests who dedicate their eternal lives to mastering arcane and divine magic. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: God-Born Monstrosity
monsters.description: Type: Creature. The unwanted offspring of a deity and another being. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Cunning Abyss Bird
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Intelligent, carnivorous, flightless birds native to the Abyss. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Undead High Priest
monsters.description: Type: Undead. High Priest of Dregoth, an undead, mummy-like dray. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Malevolent Hive Insects
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Vicious extraplanar vermin from the Abyss that possess a cruel intelligence. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Four-Armed Armored Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Massive, armor-plated demons from the Abyss with four arms. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Fiendish Corpse-Eater
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Formidable, fiendish versions of ghouls that serve abyssal powers. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Sovereign of Chaos
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Powerful and evil demonic rulers, each controlling a section of the Abyss. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Void-Born Corruptors
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Demons from a dead universe. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: The Ancient Soul-Feaster
monsters.description: Type: Creature. One of the most infamous villains, the Eternal Lich is a powerful archlich known as the "Lord of Unlife. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Four-Legged Terror Bird
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. CJ Miozzi included the achaierai on The Escapist's list of "The Dumbest Dungeons & Dragons Monsters Ever (And How To Use Them)". Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Devout Initiate
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Type: Humanoid. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Stag-Horned Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Heroic fey guardians of sylvan realms, also known as "elk centaurs. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Sylvan Elk-Hybrid
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Sylvan guardians with human torsos and elk antlers. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Ethereal Shape-Shifter
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A human-sized humanoid from the Ethereal Plane that can adapt its physical form to survive in any environment, mimicking the abilities or resistances needed for survival. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Diseased Blood-Sucker
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Thin, blood-drinking flying insect that can cause disease. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Sticky-Skinned Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Humanoid creatures whose skin exudes a glue-like substance, allowing them to trap weapons and opponents. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Great Storm Wyrm
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A powerful, older chromatic dragon with blue scales and a massive horn on its snout. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Great Frost Wyrm
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A formidable chromatic dragon with ice-white scales, adapted to freezing arctic environments. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Unseen Gale Elemental
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A form of invisible air kin elemental that can be summoned by a cleric; it is very strong and usually attacks by strangling an opponent. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Invisible Wind Wraith
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A form of invisible air kin elemental that can be summoned by a cleric; it is very strong and usually attacks by strangling an opponent. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Regional Gale Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A specific variant of the aerial servant, often associated with particular planar regions or cultures, maintaining the signature invisibility and strength of its kind. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Cloud-Wreathed Serpent
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A snake-like creature from the Plane of Air, made of living wind and clouds, often serving as guardians or mounts for powerful air-aligned beings. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Giant Flood-Beast
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A massive, whale-like lake monster of Welsh folklore, often depicted as a mix of a beaver, crocodile, and bear, capable of causing floods when it emerges from the water. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Sound-Hungry Undead
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Undead creatures that resemble ghouls but are fueled by a supernatural hunger for sound or speech, often silencing their victims before consuming them. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Hand-Tailed Water Predator
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Dangerous intelligent alligator-like water monster in Maztica. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Manifested Gale
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Powerful creatures in the game;[19] a characteristic of the air elemental is the ability of rapid movement. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Guardian Wind Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Beneficial spirits native to Shurrock (the second layer of Bytopia), closely resembling djinn. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Planar Weaver Queen
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A unique and powerful "Planar Spider" and Immortal queen of Thothia. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Shadow Ninja Ghost
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The undead spirit of a ninja who died during an important, unfulfilled mission of assassination. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Fire-Tongued Shadow Demon
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A horrific emaciated demon from the Shadowlands with a metal-like hide and three long, flaming tongues. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Shimmering Heat Being
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Also known as "Dazzles," these creatures masquerade as beautiful humanoids but are truly winged beings composed of sparkling white motes and waves of invisible heat. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Horned Golden Hare
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Based on Al-mi'raj "in Islamic poetry, a yellow hare with a single black horn on its head. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Desert Fate Creature
monsters.description: Type: Creature. The "Land of Fate" setting, characterized by its Arabian Nights-inspired atmosphere, home to unique creatures like the Al-Jahar and various genies. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Hairy Forest Giant
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Forest-dwelling humanoids distantly related to yetis, featuring barrel chests and thick hair. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Oily-Feathered Sky-Watcher
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Magical, bird-like creatures found in Wildspace with long, almost-human faces and oily feathers. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Pale Cave Dweller
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A subrace of dwarves from Chult with pale, pigmentless skin and white hair. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Transmuting Shrub
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A multi-trunked shrub from Wildspace that provides fresh air and can transform inorganic or dead organic matter into different materials upon contact. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Crustacean Man-Eater
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Upright-walking giant lobsters with humanoid faces and long eyestalks, native to the Aldani Basin in Chult. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Divine Mirror Vengeance
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A physical manifestation of divine vengeance that appears as an exact duplicate of its target. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Sentient Algae Shambler
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. An intelligent colony of algae taking a green, humanoid shape. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Great Marsh Predator
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. Also known as the "Swamp Dragon," this fat, sleek carnivore inhabits large marshes. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Brain-Eating Lich
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Undead brain-eater. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Insatiable Void Force
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A malevolent force or entity that represents insatiable greed or the literal consumption of life and matter, often found in the darker corners of the planes. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Madness-Born Wraith
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Undead spirit of someone driven to madness and suicide. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Ancient Apex Hunter
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A large carnivorous dinosaur that inhabited the Prime Material Plane, known for its powerful jaws and bipedal speed. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Reptilian Soul-Sapper
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Reptilian emotional vampires from the Spelljammer setting. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Black-Horned Rabbit
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Based on Al-mi'raj "in Islamic poetry, a yellow hare with a single black horn on its head. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Sleep-Inducing Blossom
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A beautiful but deadly plant whose blossoms can release a cloud of sleep-inducing pollen to trap and eventually consume prey. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Deadly Nectar Bloom
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A beautiful but deadly plant whose blossoms can release a cloud of sleep-inducing pollen to trap and eventually consume prey. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Sleep-Flower
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Camouflaged Pack Hunter
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. Small, social drakes that hunt in packs and use their natural camouflage to surprise prey. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Hidden Scaled Predator
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. Small, social drakes that hunt in packs and use their natural camouflage to surprise prey. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Undead Sea Raider
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Energy-draining undead corsairs. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Devourer of the Wicked
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Semi-humanoid creatures looking like a cross between crocodile, hippopotamus and female lion who consume the hama (spirits) of the wicked. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Infernal Gate Keeper
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Short, winged greater devils that serve as the arrogant and ruthless guardians of the gates to the Nine Hells and commanders of infernal legions. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Massive Slime Maw
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A massive, single-celled organism that thrives in damp, dark environments, attacking by engulfing and dissolving its prey with digestive enzymes. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Colossal Single-Cell Terror
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A massive, single-celled organism that thrives in damp, dark environments, attacking by engulfing and dissolving its prey with digestive enzymes. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Water-Born Hybrid
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Template Landbound humanoid born able to survive in water. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Two-Headed Rolling Snake
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A giant snake with a head at each end of its body, capable of striking in multiple directions simultaneously and moving by rolling in a hoop. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Chaos-Infused Being
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Template Creatures dwelling in the chaotic planes. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Manifestations of Chaos
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Template. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Ghostly Sea Captain
monsters.description: Type: Creature. The ghost of a legendary sailor or captain who is cursed to sail the seas forever, often appearing as a harbinger of doom or a vengeful spirit. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Stinging Deep-Dweller
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Large, sessile aquatic organisms with stinging tentacles used to paralyze and capture fish and other small creatures that wander too close. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Celestial Arbiter
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Described are the astral deva, planetar, and solar. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Blighted Seraph
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A horrific high-level undead creature and mockery of celestial beings, featuring rotting wings and peeling flesh. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Heavenly Hosts
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Cold Sea Eel-Hunter
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Tyler Linn of Cracked. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Frigid Deep Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Aquatic hunters that inhabit cold seas. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Primal Beast
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Described are the pack lizard, riding lizard, spitting crawler, two-headed adder, winged viper and tressym. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Stampeding Beast Group
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A large group of natural animals, such as bison or deer, moving together for protection and social interaction. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Sovereign of the Wild
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Powerful celestial spirits from the Beastlands that serve as immortal protectors of specific animal species. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Frost-Adapted Beast
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Animals adapted to extreme cold and ice, such as polar bears, seals, and arctic foxes. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Tamed Working Animal
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Erdlu: large flightless scaled bird kept for meat and eggs; inix: 16-feet carnivorous lizard used for riding and transport; kank: 8-feet-long black. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Grazing Beast
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Small animals herded or hunted for their meat and other useful body parts. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Wandering Group
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A large group of natural animals moving together for protection and social interaction. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Soothing Beetle
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Hurrum: A beetle whose wingbeats create a soothing sound. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Mundane Fauna
monsters.description: Type: Beast. "Real, ordinary animals" are adapted into the game in a separate chapter, as according to Chrulew, "they comprise their own, somewhat less interesting subset" of creatures. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Living Artifact
monsters.description: Type: Creature. Described are the tiny, small, medium, large, huge, gargantuan, and colossal animated object | Mundane object animated by magic. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Magical Constructs
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Lumbering Furniture
monsters.description: Type: Creature. A mundane wooden table brought to life by magic to serve as a guardian or a surprising combatant. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Swarming Ceramic Shards
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Small, flat constructs made of stone or ceramic tiles that can swarm and cut intruders with their sharp edges. Abilities: Natural weapons, Keen senses

monsters.name: Vessel Haunter
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A type of animator which can possess larger-sized objects. Abilities: Inanimate Possession, Phantom Kick, Poltergeist Force

monsters.name: Object Possessor
monsters.description: Type: Spirit. Malevolent spirit creatures which can possess inanimate objects to attack and harm the living. Abilities: Material Binding, Ethereal Sunder, Haunting Aura

monsters.name: Grand Manor Geist
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A type of animator which possesses huge-sized structures (houses or ships) and possesses additional magical powers. Abilities: Structure Possession, Leyline Siphon, Mass Animation

monsters.name: Trinket Spite
monsters.description: Type: Spirit. An animator which can take over only light items (daggers, ropes etc. Abilities: Minor Object Control, Sharp Edge, Quick Flicker

monsters.name: Elemental Echo
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Elemental "reflections" of Material Plane animals from the Inner Planes. Abilities: Elemental Infusion, Primal Mimicry, Planar Resonance

monsters.name: Chitinous Tunneler
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Monstrosity | Large, burrowing creature with mandibles and a chitinous shell capable of spitting acid. Abilities: Acidic Spray, Burrowing Ambush, Crushing Mandibles

monsters.name: Bastion Sauroid
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A heavily armored dinosaur with a massive club-like tail used for defense against predators. Abilities: Heavy Armor Plate, Tail Club Smash, Sturdy Stance

monsters.name: Abyssal Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A terrifying, multi-legged aberration from the Underdark. Abilities: Disintegration Touch, Multi-Limbed Strike, Psychic Wail

monsters.name: Giant Colony Drone
monsters.description: Type: Insect. Standard giant ants that live in massive colonies and are known for their strength and cooperation. Abilities: Cooperative Strength, Pincers, Pheromone Trail

monsters.name: Sand-Pit Lurker
monsters.description: Type: Insect. A massive insect that traps prey in conical pits dug into sand or loose soil. Abilities: Pitfall Trap, Sand Sinking, Mandible Grip

monsters.name: Colossal Worker Ant
monsters.description: Type: Insect. Standard giant ants that live in massive colonies and are known for their strength and cooperation. Abilities: Carrying Might, Acidic Bite, Hive Mind Defense

monsters.name: Plains Runner
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Graceful herd animals common in savannahs and plains, hunted for their meat and hides. Abilities: Swift Leap, Herd Panic, Nimble Hooves

monsters.name: Bestial Hybrid
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Template to be added to any non-dire animal. Abilities: Primal Instinct, Humanoid Agility, Senses of the Wild

monsters.name: Sun-Scorched Insectoid
monsters.description: Type: Insect. Giant desert ants. Abilities: Heat Resistance, Sand Burrow, Serrated Appendages

monsters.name: Planar Orb
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Described are the Droplet and Sphere. Abilities: Energy Reflection, Sphere Form, Droplet Divide

monsters.name: Great Primate
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Abilities: Powerful Slam, Arboreal Agility, Frightful Roar

monsters.name: Savage Jungle Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Large, aggressive apes that hunt other creatures for food, often found in dense jungles or abandoned ruins. Abilities: Flesh Tear, Blood Scent, Brutal Strength

monsters.name: Frost-Furred Simian
monsters.description: Type: Beast. White-furred apes adapted to cold mountain environments, known for their strength and ability to navigate icy terrain. Abilities: Cold Resistance, Snow Camouflage, Icy Rock Throw

monsters.name: Peak Yeti-Ape
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A rare species of ape with white fur, often found in high mountain regions or arctic jungles. Abilities: Blizzard Breath, Climbing Claws, Thick Hide

monsters.name: Peak Yeti-Ape
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A rare species of ape with white fur, often found in high mountain regions or arctic jungles. Abilities: Blizzard Breath, Climbing Claws, Thick Hide

monsters.name: Star-Bound Nomad
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A roguish, charismatic race of human spacefarers known as "space gypsies. Abilities: Navigation Mastery, Rogue Charm, Void Adaptation

monsters.name: Ghostly Manifestation
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A restless spirit or ghost that haunts a specific location, often manifesting to relay a message or terrify the living. Abilities: Terrifying Visage, Ethereal Jaunt, Chilling Touch

monsters.name: Arcane Initiate
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A low-level spellcaster who is still learning the arcane arts, often serving a more powerful wizard. Abilities: Cantrip Surge, Arcane Study, Minor Shield

monsters.name: Deep-Sea Kin
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A subrace of elves that has adapted to life underwater, possessing gills and webbed fingers and toes. Abilities: Underwater Breathing, Aquatic Grace, Spear Mastery

monsters.name: Tidal Slime
monsters.description: Type: Ooze. Described are the Bloodbloater, Flotsam Ooze, and Reekmurk. Abilities: Adhesive Grip, Water Camouflage, Dissolving Touch

monsters.name: Colossal Multi-Leg
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Giant whip scorpion, giant whip spider, giant sun spider. Abilities: Web Entangle, Venomous Bite, Multi-Leg Strike

monsters.name: Spider-Kin Mutant
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Template. Abilities: Wall Climbing, Silk Spray, Sensory Vibrations

monsters.name: Web-Weaving Sorcerer
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Intelligent giant spider capable of changing forms and of utilizing sorcerous magic. Abilities: Shapechange, Arcane Casting, Poisonous Bite

monsters.name: Eldritch Arachnid
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Originating from the Savage Coast (Mystara), Arashaeem are "pseudo-liches"—intelligent magic-using spiders (aranea) who attempted the transformation into lichdom. Abilities: Pseudo-Lich Magic, Undead Fortitude, Soul Bind

monsters.name: Psionic Shell-Crawler
monsters.description: Type: Insect. Massive, psionic beetles from the Forgotten Realms featuring rock-hard carapaces and spiked tentacles. Abilities: Psionic Spikes, Mental Shield, Tentacle Lash

monsters.name: Celestial Punisher
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Lawful good outsiders from the plane of Arcadia that serve as divine punishers of evil and chaos. Abilities: Divine Smite, Wings of Justice, Aura of Order

monsters.name: Merchants of the Stars
monsters.description: Type: Giant. Also known as Mercanes, these 12-foot-tall, blue-skinned giants are the primary merchants of the Spelljammer setting, specializing in trading magical items and spelljamming helms. Abilities: Trade Knowledge, Dimensional Pocket, Magic Sense

monsters.name: Mana-Leach Slime
monsters.description: Type: Ooze. Mindless, magic-eating oozes born from magical pollution. Abilities: Magic Absorption, Arcane Pulse, Corrosive Body

monsters.name: Stellar Trader
monsters.description: Type: Giant. A race of tall, blue-skinned merchants from the Spelljammer setting who specialize in trading magical items and spelljamming helms. Abilities: Appraisal, Long-Range Telepathy, Arcane Shield

monsters.name: Lich-Failure Specter
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The ghostly result of a powerful evil spellcaster failing the ritual to become a lich. Abilities: Shadow Step, Drain Life, Arcane Remnant

monsters.name: High Hierophant
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A high-ranking druid who has attained great power and leadership within their druidic circle. Abilities: Nature's Wrath, Wild Shape Mastery, Elemental Call

monsters.name: Master Marksman
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A skilled warrior specializing in the use of bows and other ranged weapons. Abilities: Deadeye Shot, Volley, Quick Draw

monsters.name: Thorn-Shooting Flora
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A predatory plant that fires sharp thorns at nearby creatures to kill and then consume them as fertilizer. Abilities: Needle Spray, Camouflage, Root Entangle

monsters.name: Thorn-Shooting Flora
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A predatory plant that fires sharp thorns at nearby creatures to kill and then consume them as fertilizer. Abilities: Needle Spray, Camouflage, Root Entangle

monsters.name: Arcane Overlord
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Abilities: Master Spellcasting, Arcane Shielding, Contingency

monsters.name: Prince of Elemental Fury
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Bosses on their respective planes,[188] Ed Greenwood considered the Elemental Princes of Evil "worthy additions to any campaign". Abilities: Elemental Command, Abyssal Storm, Core Explosion

monsters.name: Prince of Elemental Light
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Bosses on their respective planes. Abilities: Elemental Blessing, Radiant Aura, Harmonious Strike

monsters.name: Divine Harbinger
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Described are the lantern archon, hound archon, and trumpet archon. Abilities: Holy Radiance, Wings of Light, Truesight

monsters.name: Parchment-Winged Scribe
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Seven-foot-tall celestials from Mount Celestia with bronze skin and wings made of parchment. Abilities: Scripture Strike, Divine Message, Protective Word

monsters.name: Hundred-Eyed Void-Slug
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A horrific aberration from the Spelljammer setting that resembles a giant, translucent blue or purple amoeba covered in nearly a hundred eyes and mouths. Abilities: Multi-Gaze, Maw Lash, Translucent Form

monsters.name: Shielded Nomad
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Nomadic, desert-dwelling humanoids that resemble bipedal armadillos. Abilities: Shell Defense, Sand Step, Spear Jab

monsters.name: Abyssal Centaur-Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Centaur-like demons that serve as the heavy cavalry of the Abyss. Abilities: Thunderous Charge, Flail Strike, Demonic Gallop

monsters.name: Fiendish Cavalry
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Centaur-like demons from the Abyss that serve as heavy cavalry in fiendish armies. Abilities: Hellish Charge, Abyssal Roar, Iron Hooves

monsters.name: Aether-Slicer
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Described are the juvenile, adult, and elder arrowhawk | Bird-like creature from the Elemental Plane of Air. Abilities: Aerial Dive, Wind Buffet, Beak Snap

monsters.name: Legendary Pathfinder
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A legendary human explorer and keeper of the Ring of Winter, known for his travels in Chult and the Forgotten Realms. Abilities: Survival Instinct, Cold Mastery, Relic Hunter

monsters.name: Sand-Skitterer
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Described are the asabi and stingtail. Abilities: Leaping Strike, Tail Lash, Sand Camouflage

monsters.name: Charcoal Sea-Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Nomadic predatory fish from warm oceans that resemble charcoal-gray sharks. Abilities: Shark-Bite, Deep Dive, Scent of Blood

monsters.name: Deathless Sage
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The most revered of the Deathless (positive-energy undead) from Aerenal in Eberron. Abilities: Positive Energy Pulse, Ancient Wisdom, Spirit Guard

monsters.name: Volcanic Snouter
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A 2-foot-long creature from volcanic regions that resembles a bald, hog-nosed opossum. Abilities: Heat Resistance, Ash Burrow, Snout Tusk

monsters.name: Volcanic Snouter
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A small insectoid or elemental creature that thrives in volcanic ash and hot environments. Abilities: Heat Resistance, Ash Burrow, Snout Tusk

monsters.name: Soot-Cloud Rodent
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Small rodents that live in volcanic regions and exude a cloud of sooty smoke. Abilities: Smoke Cloud, Ember Bite, Nimble Scurry

monsters.name: Cinder-Walker
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The ashen husk is an undead. Abilities: Ash Breath, Fiery Touch, Hollow Form

monsters.name: Rust-Skinned Nomad
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Desert-dwelling humanoids with rust-colored skin and ivory eyes. Abilities: Sand Swimming, Heat Endurance, Ivory Gaze

monsters.name: Face-Grub Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Massive, grub-like demons from the Shadowlands with human faces and seven thorn-studded tentacles. Abilities: Thorn Tentacles, Screaming Face, Shadow Slither

monsters.name: Oasis Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Friendly desert dryads that live in domesticated groves. Abilities: Blossom Charm, Sand Shield, Nature's Rest

monsters.name: Pale Sand-Serpent
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Large, pale purple worms used as mounts by desert cultures. Abilities: Coil Crush, Sand Burrow, Sting Tail

monsters.name: Divine Avatar
monsters.description: Type: Celestial/Fiend. Described are the aspect of the Lord of the Pit, the Platinum Dragon, the Prince of Demons, the God of War, the Lord of Battles, the Spider Queen, the Cold Lord, the Reaper, the Blood Lord, the Chromatic Dragon, and the Undying King. Abilities: Deific Presence, Energy Pulse, Immortality Fragment

monsters.name: Wind-Horse
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Majestic, intelligent wind-horses with shimmering silver-grey coats. Abilities: Air Walk, Silver Gallop, Telepathy

monsters.name: Insectoid Tunneler
monsters.description: Type: Insect. Insectoid subterranean race resembling giant weevils. Abilities: Chitin Armor, Mandible Slice, Burrowing Speed

monsters.name: Starlight Water-Fey
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Tiny, delicate water fey that are strictly nocturnal and dissolve in sunlight. Abilities: Water Meld, Moonbeam Flash, Night Veil

monsters.name: Shadow Blade
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Type: Humanoid. Abilities: Sneak Attack, Poison Strike, Evasion

monsters.name: Infiltration Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Deceptive devils that specialize in infiltration and murder, often appearing in a cloud-like form. Abilities: Cloud Form, Backstab, Deceptive Cloak

monsters.name: Strangler Flora
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A predatory plant that appears as a normal vine but can animate to strangle and crush prey. Abilities: Constrict, Vine Lash, Camouflage

monsters.name: Strangler Flora
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Plant that strangles passers-by. Abilities: Constrict, Vine Lash, Camouflage

monsters.name: Celestial Ambush-Kin
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. eye tyrant-kin from Wildspace that resemble asteroids or small moons, using their camouflage to ambush passing ships. Abilities: Camouflage, Maw Snap, Gaze Beam

monsters.name: Psychic Automaton
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Template. Abilities: Ectoplasmic Form, Mental Link, Hardened Shell

monsters.name: Void Behemoth
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Arcane considered these monsters to "populate their periphery with true terror". Abilities: Antimagic Gaze, Pincer Crush, Severing Bite

monsters.name: Void Behemoth
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Gargantuan creature with a single black eye, gaping maw, muscular forearms, which end in pincer-like claws and serpentine lower body. Abilities: Antimagic Gaze, Pincer Crush, Severing Bite

monsters.name: Void-Blessed Kin
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Elves that have dwelled in the Astral Plane for millennia, often possessing psionic abilities and agelessness. Abilities: Psionic Step, Ageless Wisdom, Astral Bow

monsters.name: Planar Tentacle-Terror
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Prey on traveler to the astral plane. Abilities: Dimensional Tug, Ink Cloud, Multi-Tentacle Wrap

monsters.name: Emotion Echo
monsters.description: Type: Spirit. Small, psychic entities created by strong emotions in the Astral Plane, seeking a body to inhabit. Abilities: Body Possession, Psychic Pulse, Emotional Drain

monsters.name: Planar Predator
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Humanoid abomination with large claws and skull-like face. Abilities: Claw Strike, Skull Face Gaze, Hidden Step

monsters.name: Planar Predator
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A powerful, humanoid hunter from the Astral Plane, often employed as an assassin by powerful entities. Abilities: Claw Strike, Skull Face Gaze, Hidden Step

monsters.name: Justice Warrior
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Celestial messengers and warriors from the Upper Planes, known for their fierce devotion to justice. Abilities: Holy Blade, Devotion Aura, Flight

monsters.name: Three-Armed Ogre
monsters.description: Type: Giant. Very large and strong biped with a third arm on its chest. Abilities: Third Arm Bash, Brutal Strength, Rock Throw

monsters.name: Unfinished Godling
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Tyler Linn of Cracked. Abilities: Negative Energy Aura, Ray of Enfeeblement, Wail of Death

monsters.name: Herald of the Void
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A powerful undead creature spawned from the essence of an atropal, serving as a herald of death and unlife. Abilities: Death Touch, Shadow Command, Soul Siphon

monsters.name: Wild Primeval Cattle
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Large, wild cattle with massive horns, once common in the wilderness of the Material Plane. Abilities: Goring Horns, Stampede, Powerful Charge

monsters.name: Golden Burrower
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Also named golden gorger, this creature "looks like an evil, eight-legged badger". Abilities: Multi-Leg Shred, Chitin Armor, Gold Scent

monsters.name: Clockwork Helper
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Small, gnome-like constructs built by rock gnomes, often serving as assistants or guardians. Abilities: Mechanical Fix, Tool Integration, Sturdy Build

monsters.name: Iron Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Described are the Pulverizer and Hammerer. Abilities: Hammer Slam, Pulverize, Armor Plating

monsters.name: Clockwork Scorpion
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Constructs created by the wizard Tenebrous, appearing as mechanical scorpions. Abilities: Sting Lash, Pincer Grip, Metallic Shell

monsters.name: Masterwork Construct
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Complex constructs created by the wizard Triobriand, ranging from small scouts to massive guardians. Abilities: Complex Protocol, High-Speed Strike, Arcane Power

monsters.name: Rolling Boulder-Kin
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A creature from the Elemental Plane of Earth that resembles a pile of boulders, attacking by rolling into its prey. Abilities: Crushing Roll, Stone Camouflage, Slam

monsters.name: Manifestation of Destruction
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Powerful manifestations of the forces of elemental destruction, often serving as bosses in campaigns involving elemental cults. Abilities: Elemental Chaos, Boss Resilience, Primal Strike

monsters.name: Sunken-City Kin
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Aquatic humanoids that were once human, hailing from the sunken city of Avenant. Abilities: Deep-Sea Breath, Aquatic Agility, Trident Mastery

monsters.name: Sky-Winged Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A general term for bird-like creatures, ranging from normal birds to intelligent avian races. Abilities: Dive Attack, Talon Scratch, Sharp Sight

monsters.name: Angelic Griffin
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. A hybrid creature combining the features of a lion and an eagle, similar to a griffin but with a more angelic appearance. Abilities: Lion's Leap, Eagle's Sight, Holy Wing Buffet

monsters.name: Underdark Shapechanger
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Dreadful aberrations from the Underdark that can shapechange into humanoids to infiltrate and consume communities. Abilities: Shapechange, Community Infiltration, Mind Lash

monsters.name: Sentient Bush
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Abilities: False Appearance, Twig Scratch, Root Step

monsters.name: Sentient Oak
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Abilities: Branch Slam, Sturdy Bark, Root Trap

monsters.name: Sentient Giant Fungus
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A massive fungus that has been granted sentience through magic, common in the Underdark. Abilities: Spore Cloud, Fungal Growth, Slam

monsters.name: Cleaver Strider
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A towering, flightless avian with a plumage of iron-grey feathers and a massive, wedge-shaped beak that glints like polished steel. It stands on muscular legs capable of shattering bone with a single kick, and it is known to roam the vast open plains in territorial flocks. Abilities: Sunder Peck: Delivers a powerful blow with its heavy beak, Serrated Kick: A swift strike that leaves deep lacerations

monsters.name: Wedge-Billed Runner
monsters.description: Type: Beast. These majestic, ostrich-like birds possess a beak that tapers into a razor-sharp edge, perfect for cutting through dense undergrowth or the armor of prey. Domesticated by nomadic tribes, they serve as swift mounts capable of enduring long treks across arid landscapes. Abilities: Galloping Charge: Rams into enemies with full speed, Razor Snapped: A quick biting motion that can sever limbs

monsters.name: Immutable Construct-Soul
monsters.description: Type: Outer-Planar Entity. A creature infused with the rigid geometry of the celestial gears. Its form is perfectly symmetrical, often shimmering with a mathematical precision that unnerves those of chaotic mind. Every movement is calculated, and its presence radiates an aura of unwavering order. Abilities: Geometric Precision: Attacks never miss their mark, Aura of Stasis: Temporarily freezes chaotic impulses in nearby foes

monsters.name: Patterned Exemplar
monsters.description: Type: Template. An entity that has been overwritten by the fundamental laws of the universe. Its skin or shell is etched with glowing fractals and perfect equations. It exists as a living proof of universal constants, purging all traces of random chance from its immediate vicinity. Abilities: Deterministic Strike: Forces a predictable outcome on an attack, Logic Pulse: Emits a wave of energy that disrupts magical fluctuations

monsters.name: Flesh-Borer Brood
monsters.description: Type: Fiendish Parasite. A cloud of tiny, multi-legged horrors with translucent wings and needle-like proboscises. Individually insignificant, as a swarm they descend upon larger prey, burrowing into soft tissue and devouring the host from within while emitting a high-pitched, mocking chitter. Abilities: Internal Infestation: Burrows into the target's skin, Collective Cacophony: Disorients enemies with deafening buzzing

monsters.name: Crimson Arcanist of the Scale
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid Spellcaster. Clad in robes the color of fresh blood, this sorcerer bears the mark of the dragon on his brow. His eyes burn with the fire of ancient knowledge, and he is often surrounded by a faint smell of sulfur and charred parchment as he manipulates the strings of dragon-worshipping fanatics. Abilities: Incendiary Incantation: Unleashes a blast of draconic fire, Wyrm-Voice: Commands lesser reptilian creatures with a word

monsters.name: Magma-Forged Kin
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Short, stout beings composed of living brass and obsidian, their hair and beards crackling with eternal flames. They are master smiths who dwell within the heart of volcanoes, hammering out artifacts on anvils made of solidified heat while their bodies radiate an intense, scorching warmth. Abilities: Searing Touch: Burns anything it handles, Heat Shield: Absorbs fire-based attacks to empower its next strike

monsters.name: Soul-Bound Human
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Humans born with eyes that mirror the swirling blue mists of the soul-realms. They possess a natural talent for weaving raw spiritual energy into physical manifestations. However, this power comes at a cost, as their lifespans are drastically shortened by the intensity of the magic coursing through their veins. Abilities: Essence Weave: Shapes raw soul-energy into weapons, Rapid Insight: Gains temporary combat expertise at the cost of vitality

monsters.name: The Chronicle of Trials
monsters.description: Type: Sentient Grimoire. A levitating tome bound in dragonhide that contains the shifting blueprints of countless dungeons. It acts as a guardian of forbidden knowledge, manifesting illusions of past heroes and traps to deter those who seek to unlock its secrets without proper initiation. Abilities: Manifest Memory: Summons phantom warriors, Labyrinthine Shift: Changes the local terrain to confuse intruders

monsters.name: Four-Armed Titan of the Waste
monsters.description: Type: Giant. A massive, primitive humanoid with four powerful arms and skin like cracked clay. These giants roam the endless dunes, using their multiple limbs to wield massive stone clubs or to scale sheer canyon walls with terrifying speed. They are driven by a simple, brutal survival instinct. Abilities: Quad-Strike: Attacks four times in rapid succession, Earth-Shaking Leap: Creates a shockwave upon landing

monsters.name: Quad-Limbed Wanderer
monsters.description: Type: Giant. Towering humanoids that have adapted to the harshest environments. Their four arms allow them to multitask with lethal efficiency, often carrying both weapons and supplies simultaneously. They are nomadic and fiercely protective of the rare water sources they claim as their own. Abilities: Multi-Limb Defense: Parries multiple attacks at once, Crushing Grip: Pinions a foe with two arms while striking with the others

monsters.name: Diamond Sentinel
monsters.description: Type: Construct/Elemental. A monolithic entity carved from a single, indestructible diamond. In some regions, it takes the form of a fluid-like spirit of the deep, dragging unsuspecting travelers into the crushing depths. It serves as a silent, eternal protector of submerged treasures and forgotten ruins. Abilities: Reflective Shell: Bounces spells back at the caster, Drowning Vortex: Creates a powerful suction in the water

monsters.name: Infernal Sovereign
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Masters of intrigue and iron-fisted rule, these devils embody the concept of structured malice. They are tall, regal figures with charred wings and eyes that hold the weight of a thousand corrupt contracts. They value order above all else, provided they are the ones giving the orders. Abilities: Contractual Binding: Forces a target into a magical agreement, Hellfire Lash: Strikes with a whip of pure suffering

monsters.name: Dross-Soul
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A pathetic, quivering mass of melted flesh and mournful moans. These are the remnants of the most wicked souls, stripped of all identity and reduced to a semi-liquid state. They crawl through the filth of the lower planes, serving as endless, mindless laborers for their infernal masters. Abilities: Sloughing Form: Regenerates quickly but is easily dispersed, Wailing Hunger: Bites with a toothless but caustic maw

monsters.name: Hell-Gate Overseer
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Pudgy, winged devils with wide, cruel mouths and a deceptive air of incompetence. In reality, they are brilliant tacticians and keepers of the infernal portals. They use their mental prowess to dominate the minds of those who attempt to pass through their domains without permission. Abilities: Mind-Numbing Touch: Erases the target's recent memories, Portal Command: Can summon reinforcements through planar rifts

monsters.name: Spiked Chain Terror
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Massive, muscular fiends covered in jagged scales and wielding heavy, barbed chains that seem to move with a life of their own. They serve as the elite shock troops of the infernal legions, their massive wings beating a rhythm of war as they descend upon the front lines to sow carnage. Abilities: Bleeding Chain: Wounds from its weapon continue to bleed, Intimidating Roar: Shakes the resolve of even the bravest warriors

monsters.name: Frost-Bite Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Towering, insect-like horrors with translucent, blue-tinted carapaces and segmented limbs that end in needle-sharp points. They radiate a cold so intense it can shatter steel. Known for their calculating cruelty, they observe the battlefield with cold, multifaceted eyes before striking. Abilities: Glacial Spear: A thrust that freezes the target's blood, Numbing Cold: Slows the movement of everyone nearby

monsters.name: Lord of the Burning Pit
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. The pinnacle of infernal evolution, these massive, bat-winged lords stand over twelve feet tall. Their skin is like cooling magma, and their breath is a toxic cloud of ash and sulfur. They command legions with a thought and possess the raw power to level fortresses. Abilities: Magma Breath: A cone of molten rock and fire, Overlord's Decree: Commands subordinates to die for its benefit

monsters.name: Bloated Sinner
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Grotesquely swollen, eyeless creatures that shuffle forward in an endless, mindless mass. They are the lowest form of infernal life, used primarily to soak up enemy fire or to provide a grisly carpet for more powerful fiends to walk upon. They smell of rot and old grease. Abilities: Foul Odor: Nauseates nearby enemies, Mindless Advance: Immune to fear and mind-control

monsters.name: Spiny Messenger
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Small, agile devils covered in sharp quills that they can launch like arrows. They dart through the air on leathery wings, acting as scouts and heralds for the infernal lords. Their voices are high-pitched and grating, often delivering news of impending doom. Abilities: Quill Volley: Shoots a spray of spines, Aerial Dash: Moves with unnatural speed in the air

monsters.name: Draconic Scion of Hell
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. These gargoyle-like fiends bear the distinct features of chromatic dragons, from their scale color to the shape of their horns. They are the personal servants of the Queen of Evil Dragons, blending the cunning of a devil with the elemental ferocity of a wyrm. Abilities: Elemental Strike: Attacks deal damage based on their scale color, Stone Flight: Can turn into stone to plummet onto foes

monsters.name: Bearded Ravager
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Fierce, red-skinned warriors with long, wiry beards that are actually composed of venomous tentacles. They wield massive, serrated polearms and fight with a reckless abandon that makes them terrifying opponents on the battlefield. They are the grunt soldiers of the infernal host. Abilities: Venomous Beard: A secondary attack that poisons, Frenzied Glaive: A series of wide, sweeping strikes

monsters.name: Hellsent Avenger
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Strikingly beautiful figures with dark wings and eyes that burn with a cold, vengeful light. They are the seekers of oath-breakers and fugitives from infernal justice. Armed with flaming bows and ropes of enchanted silk, they never tire in their pursuit of those who have crossed the lords of Hell. Abilities: Flame-Shot: Arrows that ignite on impact, Entangling Lasso: Binds a target in magical rope

monsters.name: Barbed Impaler
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Lean, predatory fiends whose entire bodies are a forest of long, iron-hard spines. They specialize in grappling their prey and dragging them against their spiked skin, ensuring a slow and painful death. Their movements are jerky and unsettling, like a broken puppet. Abilities: Spined Embrace: Deals damage when grappling, Impaling Leap: Launches itself at a foe to pin them

monsters.name: Chitinous Surgeon
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Insectoid devils with multiple sets of spindly arms, each ending in a different surgical tool or needle. They are the master torturers of the lower planes, finding great joy in the biological deconstruction of their victims to "study" the limits of mortal suffering. Abilities: Anatomical Precision: Attacks deal extra damage to vital organs, Paralytic Injection: Stings the target to induce paralysis

monsters.name: Skeleton Judge
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Tall, skeletal beings with bleached white bones and a long, scorpion-like tail that drips with a numbing venom. They act as the internal police of the infernal realms, sniffing out dissent and treason among the lesser devils with an almost psychic efficiency. Abilities: Bone-Chill: A gaze that freezes the target in place, Stinging Judgment: A tail strike that drains the victim's resolve

monsters.name: Shell-Back Scavenger
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Small, low-slung reptilians protected by a thick, bony shell. They spend their days burrowing beneath the sand to escape the heat, emerging at night to scavenge for scraps or small insects. They are hardy survivors, capable of going weeks without water. Abilities: Shell Retraction: Gains a massive boost to defense, Sand-Diver: Quickly disappears into loose earth

monsters.name: Gravel-Crusher
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A mutated, much larger relative of the common scavenger. Its front claws have grown into massive, bone-crushing implements that it uses to crack open the shells of other creatures or to dig deep into the bedrock. It is highly aggressive and territorial. Abilities: Bone-Cracker: Ignores a portion of the target's armor, Terrifying Hiss: Emits a sound that causes panic

monsters.name: Matriarch of the Flying Skull
monsters.description: Type: Hag. An ancient, gnarled witch who resides in a hut that walks on giant chicken legs. She is known to traverse the skies within a massive, hollowed-out giant's skull. Her power over the swamp is absolute, and she is said to be the secret mother of the land's dark lord. Abilities: Skull Flight: Moves rapidly through the air, Blight-Wave: Corrupts the earth and plants around her

monsters.name: Canyon Ape
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Agile primates with colorful muzzles and sharp canine teeth. They live in large, organized troops and are notorious for their cleverness and aggressive defense of their territory. Their barking calls can be heard echoing through the canyons for miles. Abilities: Pack Tactics: Gains an advantage when fighting alongside allies, Acrobatics: Easily scales vertical surfaces

monsters.name: Stone-Climber Simian
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A larger, sturdier version of the common ape, adapted to life among the jagged rocks of high-altitude peaks. Their fur is thick and grey, blending perfectly with the stone. They are known to throw rocks at intruders with surprising accuracy. Abilities: Rock Hurl: Deals significant damage at range, Crag-Grip: Cannot be knocked prone on rocky terrain

monsters.name: Reveler of the Wild
monsters.description: Type: Fey-Touched Humanoid. These wild-eyed wanderers are permanently enthralled by a state of divine intoxication. They dance through the forests in a frenzy of music and wine, oblivious to danger. However, if their revelry is interrupted, they turn into savage beasts, tearing at their foes with bare hands. Abilities: Infectious Joy: Forces others to join the dance, Primal Frenzy: Increases attack speed when provoked

monsters.name: Vicious Burrower
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A low-set, powerful mammal with distinctive striped markings and long, curved claws. While small, it is legendary for its fearlessness, often standing its ground against predators ten times its size. It lives in complex underground tunnels. Abilities: Relentless Rage: Continues fighting even when severely wounded, Tunnel-Strike: Attacks from beneath the ground

monsters.name: Guardian Specter of the High Elves
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Unlike most liches, these noble spirits have embraced unlife not out of greed, but out of a sense of eternal duty. They appear as withered but regal elven elders, often glowing with a soft, moonlight-like radiance as they stand watch over their people's most precious legacies. Abilities: Moonlight Ward: Creates a protective barrier of light, Wisdom of Ages: Can predict an enemy's next move

monsters.name: Underdark Chiropteran
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Small, bat-featured humanoids with large, sensitive ears and leathery wings attached to their arms. They are master scouts of the deep places, moving in total silence through the darkness. They communicate using high-pitched clicks that are inaudible to most other races. Abilities: Echolocation: Detects hidden enemies, Shadow-Slip: Becomes nearly invisible in dim light

monsters.name: Clawed Nature-Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Fey. A squat, bloated humanoid spirit with skin the color of moss and hands that end in long, obsidian-like talons. It is a spiteful protector of the deepest jungles, setting traps for those who would harm the ancient trees or hunt the rare animals of its domain. Abilities: Root-Bind: Commands plants to entangle foes, Poisoned Claws: Scratches cause a lingering sickness

monsters.name: Dwarven-Blight Goblin
monsters.description: Type: Goblinoid. Stout, grey-skinned goblins with bulging muscles and a deep-seated hatred for all things orderly. They often wear scavenged armor and carry heavy, crude weapons. They are more disciplined than their common cousins, often forming effective military units. Abilities: Shield Wall: Gains defense when standing next to allies, Brutal Cleave: A heavy swing that hits multiple foes

monsters.name: Pale-Skin Prowler
monsters.description: Type: Goblinoid. These albino goblinoids are born and bred in the absolute darkness of the deepest mines. Their skin is translucent and their eyes are a piercing red. They move with a supernatural fluidness, specializing in raiding surface settlements during the darkest nights. Abilities: Light-Blind: Stronger in the dark, weaker in the light, Silent Step: Moves without making any sound

monsters.name: Nightmare-Eater
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. A majestic creature with the trunk of an elephant, the paws of a tiger, and the hide of a rhinoceros. It is a benevolent being that wanders the dreamscape, seeking out the nightmares of children and devouring them to leave behind only peaceful sleep. Abilities: Dream-Purge: Removes mental debuffs from allies, Roar of Clarity: Dispels illusions and charms

monsters.name: Star-Whale of the Heavens
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Enormous, whale-like beings that "swim" through the ether of the upper planes. Their skin is etched with constellations that glow with a gentle, golden light. They are gentle giants, often acting as living ships for those traveling between the divine realms. Abilities: Astral Wake: Increases the speed of nearby allies, Song of Peace: Prevents violence in its immediate vicinity

monsters.name: Shifting Deceiver
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A rare entity that has no true form, instead existing as a localized distortion in reality. It can project complex illusions that are indistinguishable from the real world, and it can warp its own mass into any shape it desires to better hunt or hide. Abilities: Reality Warp: Briefly changes the physical properties of an object, Hallucinatory Terrain: Makes a pit look like solid ground

monsters.name: Psychic Slitherer
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A massive, pale worm with hundreds of tiny, twitching legs and a cluster of long, sensory tentacles at its head. It feeds on the psychic energy of intelligent creatures, tracking them by the "scent" of their thoughts before dragging them into a pocket dimension. Abilities: Thought-Siphon: Drains the target's mental energy, Reality Fold: Teleports itself and a grappled foe

monsters.name: Shadow-Frog Terror
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A bloated, toad-like creature with skin like dark, wet leather and a mouth wide enough to swallow a man whole. It is a creature of shadow, capable of stepping through the darkness to ambush its prey before disappearing back into the mists. Abilities: Shadow Step: Teleports between shadows, Sticky Tongue: Pulls a target into its maw

monsters.name: Highway Marauder
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Desperate or greedy individuals who have turned to a life of crime. They frequent lonely roads and forest paths, preying on merchants and travelers. While individually weak, they are dangerous when they outnumber their victims. Abilities: Dirty Fighting: Uses sand or mud to blind, Ambush: Deals extra damage if the target is surprised

monsters.name: Warlord of the Road
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A seasoned veteran who leads a band of outlaws with an iron fist. They are better armed and armored than their subordinates and possess a keen tactical mind, often orchestrating complex heists and raids on fortified caravans. Abilities: Tactical Command: Boosts the attacks of nearby allies, Parry and Riposte: Deflects an attack and strikes back

monsters.name: Withered Vengeance
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Revenants of a dark god's followers, these undead appear as dessicated corpses with one arm mutated into a massive, three-fingered claw. They are driven by a single-minded desire to destroy any who do not bow to their master's will. Abilities: Necrotic Claw: A strike that prevents healing, Unyielding Hate: Cannot be turned or frightened

monsters.name: Vile-Ribbed Skeleton
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Skeletons infused with dark energy, their bones turning a sickly shade of green. They move with a jerky, unnatural speed and are often used as guardians for the tombs of evil priests. They are more intelligent than common skeletons. Abilities: Bone-Spark: A burst of negative energy when damaged, Shield Bash: Knocks the target back

monsters.name: Naga-Serpent of the Mist
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A massive serpent with a humanoid head and several smaller snake heads sprouting from its neck. It is a highly intelligent and magical creature, often gathering followers who worship it as a minor deity. It speaks in a hypnotic, multilayered voice. Abilities: Multi-Bite: All heads strike at once, Hypnotic Sway: Charms those who look at it

monsters.name: High Priest of Corruption
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A lich who has dedicated its eternal existence to the service of a god of tyranny. It wears ornate, blackened plate armor and carries a staff of charred bone. Its presence causes the very air to thicken with the smell of old blood and incense. Abilities: Tyrant's Gaze: Paralyzes with fear, Dark Miracle: Heals undead allies while damaging the living

monsters.name: Screaming Wraith
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The translucent spirit of a woman who died in a state of profound grief or rage. She floats above the ground, her face a mask of eternal agony. Her presence is heralded by a sudden drop in temperature and the sound of distant, mournful sobbing. Abilities: Death Wail: A scream that can stop a heart, Corrupting Touch: Drains the vitality of the living

monsters.name: Stone-Moaner
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The spirit of a dwarf who died before fulfilling a solemn oath or completing a masterpiece. They appear as grey, spectral figures carrying phantom tools, and their wail sounds like the grinding of massive stones deep within the earth. Abilities: Echoing Sob: Causes deafness and confusion, Vow-Bind: Forces the target to complete a task

monsters.name: Tragic Geist
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A weaker variant of the screaming wraith, usually formed from the souls of those who died in common tragedies. They are more likely to haunt the place of their death, weeping for their lost lives and attacking any who disturb their sorrow. Abilities: Sorrowful Moan: Inflicts a deep melancholy, Phantom Scratch: A cold strike that bypasses armor

monsters.name: Mischievous Glade-Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Spiteful fey creatures with slender builds and skin that changes color like a chameleon. They carry intricate wooden flutes that they can use to play enchanting melodies or as blowguns to fire poisoned needles with unerring accuracy. Abilities: Drowsy Tune: Puts listeners to sleep, Needle-Shot: Fires a paralyzing dart

monsters.name: Cursed Sylph
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Once beautiful pixies who were corrupted by a dark curse. They now appear as stunning women in long, flowing dresses that hide their bird-like feet. They lure travelers into dances that never end, slowly draining the life force of their partners. Abilities: Eternal Dance: Traps a target in a rhythmic trance, Blood-Sip: Heals itself by damaging the target

monsters.name: Demon-Blooded Minotaur
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A horrific hybrid of human, bull, and demon. These creatures are larger and more aggressive than standard minotaurs, with skin covered in glowing runes and horns that drip with acidic ichor. They were created as the perfect siege infantry for planar wars. Abilities: Acidic Gore: Horn attacks deal extra acid damage, Demonic Roar: Increases its strength for a short time

monsters.name: The Horned Prince of Beasts
monsters.description: Type: Fiend Lord. A colossal demon lord with the head of a black-furred bull and a body of rippling muscle. He wields a massive glaive and rules over a domain of infinite twisting corridors. He is the patron of all who embrace their primal, savage instincts. Abilities: Maze-Mastery: Can never be lost and can manipulate walls, Savage Dominion: Commands all beasts to attack

monsters.name: Abyssal Ape
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Large, orange-furred demons that resemble massive orangutans with cruel, intelligent eyes. They are incredibly agile, leaping between planar trees or floating islands with ease. They prefer to ambush their prey from above, dragging them into the heights. Abilities: Leaping Ambush: A pounce attack from a height, Shadow-Camouflage: Blends into any background

monsters.name: Traveling Skald
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A master of story and song who has learned to weave magic into their performances. They are jacks-of-all-trades, possessing a wide array of skills and a collection of tales from across the world. They can inspire greatness in others or sow discord among enemies. Abilities: Inspiring Anthem: Buffs the attacks of allies, Cutting Wit: Disorients and damages the ego of a foe

monsters.name: Plague-Horned Ogre
monsters.description: Type: Giant. A hideous relative of the minotaur, afflicted with a magical disease that causes its flesh to rot while it still lives. It has the head of a diseased ram and a body covered in weeping sores. Despite its appearance, it is incredibly strong and resilient. Abilities: Contagious Touch: Spreads a rotting sickness, Stench of Decay: Nauseates anyone nearby

monsters.name: Goblin-Wolf Shifter
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A fiendish entity that can take the form of a large, intelligent goblin or a massive, shadow-furred wolf. It feeds on the souls of fallen warriors to grow in power. In goblin form, it is a cunning leader; in wolf form, a relentless predator. Abilities: Soul-Feed: Gains temporary hit points from kills, Shape-Shift: Toggles between humanoid and beast forms

monsters.name: Goat-Centaur of the Planes
monsters.description: Type: Celestial-Kin. These creatures have the upper body of a muscular human and the lower body of a powerful mountain goat. They are known for their boisterous personalities, their love of travel, and their stubbornness in the face of danger. They are often seen wandering the cross-planar trade routes. Abilities: Headbutt: A powerful charge with its horns, Sure-Footed: Immune to being knocked prone

monsters.name: Platypus-Rat
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A bizarre creature with six legs, a rat-like body, and a broad, flat bill similar to a platypus. Its fur is coarse and water-repellent, and it possesses a row of needle-sharp teeth. It is a social animal, living in large colonies along the edges of muddy rivers. Abilities: Triple-Swipe: Attacks with three legs at once, Murky Hide: Difficult to see underwater

monsters.name: Shadow-Coven Initiate
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Witches who have pledged their souls to a dark master in exchange for longevity and magical power. They dress in tattered black rags and carry brooms made of human hair. They specialize in curses and the brewing of toxic concoctions. Abilities: Hex-Cast: Inflicts a random debuff, Cauldron-Burst: Throws a flask of boiling, magical oil

monsters.name: Steel-Fin Predator
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Long, silver fish with a sleek profile and a mouth full of jagged teeth. They are the "wolves of the sea," known for their incredible bursts of speed and their habit of following larger creatures to scavenge scraps. They are highly attracted to shiny objects. Abilities: Lightning Dash: A sudden, high-speed strike, Snap-Bite: Can bite through metal and bone

monsters.name: Grave-Bound Revenants
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A group of undead warriors who were once a famed adventuring party. Bound by a curse of greed, they now haunt the very barrows they once tried to rob. They retain their original gear, though it is now rusted and infused with necrotic energy. Abilities: Vengeful Synergy: Gains power when near other barrowhaunts, Spectral Arsenal: Attacks with phantom weapons

monsters.name: Petrifying Saurian
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A low-slung, eight-legged reptile with a series of glowing yellow eyes. Its skin is thick and stony, providing excellent protection against physical attacks. It moves slowly but with a deliberate, terrifying purpose, knowing that its gaze is its greatest weapon. Abilities: Calcifying Gaze: Slowly turns the target to stone, Stony Bite: A bite that can crush rock

monsters.name: Stone-Glare Lizards
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. These prehistoric reptiles are the bane of explorers. A single look from their many eyes can end an adventurer's journey permanently. They are often found surrounded by the lifelike statues of their previous victims, which they occasionally gnaw on for minerals. Abilities: Flash-Freeze: A sudden gaze that paraylzes, Rocky Camouflage: Blends into cave walls

monsters.name: Dream-Stalker Shadow
monsters.description: Type: Undead. An incorporeal entity that resembles a long, spindly shadow with glowing purple eyes. It does not attack the body directly; instead, it hovers over sleeping victims, inhaling their dreams and leaving behind only a hollow, exhausted shell of a person. Abilities: Nightmare Inhalation: Drains mana or energy from sleeping targets, Shadow-Melt: Becomes intangible in darkness

monsters.name: Leather-Winged Flier
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Small, furry mammals with leathery wings that allow for incredibly agile flight. They spend their days hanging upside down in dark places and emerge at night to hunt insects. While mostly harmless, they can carry diseases and are unsettling in large numbers. Abilities: Sonic Ping: Locates objects in total darkness, Swarm-Dive: A collective attack from a colony

monsters.name: Cavern-Wing Horror
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Large bats that have adapted to the permanent darkness of the deep earth. Some variants are skeletal, while others have evolved long, needle-like fangs to drain the blood of subterranean giants. They are highly territorial and aggressive. Abilities: Blood-Drain: Heals by biting, Piercing Screech: Disorients and deafens

monsters.name: Apex Sky-Hunter
monsters.description: Type: Beast. With a wingspan reaching over ten feet, these massive bats are the undisputed masters of the night sky. They are capable of lifting a full-grown man into the air, often dropping their prey from great heights to finish them off before feeding. Abilities: Snatch and Drop: Carries a target into the air, Gust-Wing: Knocks enemies back with a flap

monsters.name: Gothic Sentinel
monsters.description: Type: Beast-Kin. Darker and more intelligent than common bats, these creatures often serve as eyes and ears for powerful vampires or necromancers. Their fur is as black as coal, and their eyes burn with a faint, unnatural red light. They seem to understand speech. Abilities: Telepathic Link: Shares sight with its master, Fear-Inducing Chirp: Causes magical dread

monsters.name: Fungal Flyer
monsters.description: Type: Plant/Beast. A bizarre hybrid of bat and fungus. Its wings are made of leathery mushroom caps, and its body is a mass of compressed mycelium. As it flies, it releases a trail of toxic spores that can cause hallucinations or rapid fungal growth in anything they touch. Abilities: Spore-Cloud: Releases a gas that confuses enemies, Fungal Graft: Its bite causes mushrooms to grow on the wound

monsters.name: Leaping Toad-Hound
monsters.description: Type: Beast. This creature has the muscular body of a bulldog but the powerful, folded hind legs of a giant bullfrog. It can leap incredible distances to close the gap with its prey, delivering a crushing bite before the victim even knows it's being hunted. Abilities: Comet Leap: A massive jump that deals damage on landing, Lock-Jaw: A bite that is nearly impossible to break

monsters.name: Frog-Thistle Construct
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A mass of thorny vines and thick roots shaped into the form of a giant frog. It is an artificial creation designed to serve as a living trap. Its "skin" is covered in razor-sharp briers that snag and tear at anything that gets too close. Abilities: Thorn-Lash: Strikes with a vine whip, Briar-Trap: Roots itself and becomes an impassable wall of thorns

monsters.name: Ursine Behemoth
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Massive, thick-furred mammals with powerful claws and a surprisingly keen sense of smell. They are apex predators but will also scavenge or eat honey and berries. A single swipe of their paw can be fatal to an armored warrior. Abilities: Bear-Hug: Grapples and crushes the target, Roar of the Wild: Intimidates smaller creatures

monsters.name: Forest Prowler Bear
monsters.description: Type: Beast. The most agile of the bear species, known for its ability to climb trees with ease. It is generally shy but can be extremely dangerous if cornered or if it feels its cubs are threatened. Its fur is dense and dark. Abilities: Tree-Ambush: Drops from branches onto prey, Rapid-Swipe: Two quick claw attacks

monsters.name: Grizzled Mauler
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A massive bear with a distinctive hump on its shoulders and long, light-colored claws. It is a solitary hunter, often found near salmon-rich rivers. Its strength is legendary, and its thick hide makes it difficult to take down with mundane weapons. Abilities: Ground-Slam: Creates a small tremor, Terrifying Charge: A full-speed run that knocks foes aside

monsters.name: Glacier-Crusher
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A bear perfectly adapted for the harshest winters. Its white fur provides perfect camouflage against the snow, and its large paws act like natural snowshoes. It is a patient hunter, often waiting hours by an ice hole for prey to emerge. Abilities: Frost-Resistance: Immune to cold damage, Icy Maul: Attacks have a chance to freeze

monsters.name: White-Death Bear
monsters.description: Type: Beast. The largest land predator in the world, this bear is as comfortable in the freezing water as it is on land. Its thick layer of blubber and waterproof fur keep it warm in sub-zero temperatures. It is a relentless tracker, following the scent of prey for miles. Abilities: Swimming Strike: Gains speed and power in water, Blubber-Armor: Reduces incoming physical damage

monsters.name: Great Forest Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Magical Beast. A noble hybrid with the loyalty of a dog and the power of a bear. They are highly intelligent and serve as protectors of the natural world. Their fur is a mix of gold and brown, and their eyes shine with an inner light of benevolence. Abilities: Warden's Bark: Alerts all allies to hidden dangers, Protective Circle: Stands over a fallen ally to shield them

monsters.name: Abyssal Abomination
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A shifting, horrific mockery of a natural animal. Its form is never stable, with tentacles sprouting from its eyes and extra mouths opening and closing along its flanks. It radiates a foul stench and an aura of pure, unadulterated chaos that sickens the soul. Abilities: Shifting Form: Becomes harder to hit as its shape changes, Chaos-Gaze: Forces the target to attack its own allies

monsters.name: The Hunter's Shadow
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A dark, predatory entity that can take the form of various hunting beasts, such as a black panther or a giant bat. It is the physical manifestation of the bloodlust inherent in the hunt, serving as the ultimate test for those who call themselves trackers. Abilities: Shadow-Melt: Becomes invisible in dim light, Blood-Scent: Tracks wounded targets across any distance

monsters.name: Tyrant's Hound
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A template applied to creatures that have been corrupted by the essence of a god of hatred and fear. They appear as shadowy, green-eyed versions of themselves, their bodies wreathed in a cold, sickly flame that drains the hope of all who see them. Abilities: Hatred Aura: Causes nearby enemies to become hostile to everyone, Dreadful Bite: A bite that inflicts magical fear

monsters.name: Necro-Carrion
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Any animal that has been reanimated through dark necromancy. They retain their primal instincts but are now driven by a mindless hunger for living flesh. Their bodies are often in various states of decay, with exposed bone and rotting muscle. Abilities: Undead Resilience: Harder to kill than a living beast, Grave-Rot: Bites cause a necrotic infection

monsters.name: Feral Primitive
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Humanoids who have rejected civilization to embrace their bestial nature. They have thick body hair, elongated facial features, and sharp claws. They live in nomadic tribes, hunting with crude stone weapons and communicating in a series of grunts and howls. Abilities: Primal Senses: Advantage on tracking and perception, Savage Strike: Deals extra damage with simple weapons

monsters.name: Demon-Hunter Arachnid
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A massive, misshapen spider from the lower planes. Its body is covered in thick, chitinous plates, and its legs are long enough to span a wide chasm. It does not hunt mortals; instead, it specializes in tracking and devouring other demons. Abilities: Web of Corruption: Traps and drains the essence of fiends, Armor-Piercing Fangs: Can bite through magical plate

monsters.name: Drone of the Golden Hive
