monsters.description: Type: Beast. As large as a pony, these bees are the industrious workers of massive, hillside hives. They are generally peaceful unless their hive is threatened, at which point they attack in a buzzing frenzy, using their massive stingers to deliver a lethal dose of venom. Abilities: Kamikaze Sting: A massive attack that kills the bee, Pollen-Dust: Blinds enemies in a cloud of yellow powder

monsters.name: Carapace Titan
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A broad category of giant insects protected by thick, iridescent shells. They come in many varieties, from those that spray acid to those that glow in the dark. They are often used as pack animals or mounts by underground races. Abilities: Shell-Bash: Rams with its thick carapace, Mandible-Crush: A powerful bite that can sever limbs

monsters.name: Shield-Scarab
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Tiny beetles with shells as hard as tempered steel. They can be trained to cling to a person's forearm, acting as a living buckler. When commanded, they can fly out to intercept incoming arrows before returning to their master's arm. Abilities: Living Shield: Provides a bonus to defense, Missile-Intercept: Can block a ranged attack

monsters.name: Neural-Parasite Beetle
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A small, inconspicuous beetle that waits in the shadows for a victim to pass by. It then leaps onto the neck and sinks its long, needle-like proboscis into the spinal column, feeding directly on the target's nerve endings and causing excruciating pain. Abilities: Pain-Bond: Transfers damage taken by the beetle to the host, Neuro-Toxin: Paralyzes the target's limbs

monsters.name: Seismic Goliath
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A truly colossal beetle with a head resembling that of a dragon and multiple sets of thick, spider-like legs. When it strikes the ground with its massive front limbs, it can cause localized earthquakes that topple buildings and open fissures in the earth. Abilities: Earth-Quake: Creates difficult terrain and deals damage, Dragon-Head Snap: A powerful biting attack

monsters.name: Fault-Line Behemoth
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. These massive insects are thought to be the cause of tremors in the foothills. Their armor is made of solidified lava, and they feed on the mineral-rich earth. They are slow-moving but nearly unstoppable once they gain momentum. Abilities: Tremor-Sense: Detects movement through the ground, Magma-Spit: Projects a glob of molten rock

monsters.name: Titan Scarab
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Common giant beetles that roam the underworld. They are hardy and adaptable, feeding on fungus or carrion. Their shells are often harvested by subterranean civilizations to make lightweight but strong armor and shields. Abilities: Acidic Spray: Projects a cone of corrosive liquid, Burrow: Moves quickly through loose earth

monsters.name: Iron-Shell Beetle
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A giant beetle with a shell so hard it can deflect crossbow bolts. It spends its life turning over the forest floor in search of food. While not naturally aggressive, it will charge anyone who gets in its way. Abilities: Ram-Charge: Deals damage and knocks back, Hardened Wings: Can fly short distances in a straight line

monsters.name: Flesh-Eater Swarm
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Individually the size of a fist, these beetles are never found alone. In a swarm, they can strip a large animal to the bone in a matter of seconds. They are often used as guardians for the resting places of ancient kings. Abilities: Swarm-Consume: Deals continuous damage to anyone inside the swarm, Burial-Hush: Moves silently across sand

monsters.name: True-Sight Rodent
monsters.description: Type: Magical Beast. A small, mouse-like creature with fur that shifts color to match its surroundings perfectly. It is exceptionally intelligent and possesses the natural ability to see through all illusions and invisibility, making it a prized companion for adventurers. Abilities: Illusion-Bane: Automatically detects magical deception, Camouflage-Shift: Becomes invisible while stationary

monsters.name: Primordial Titan-Beast
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A general term for massive, prehistoric creatures that have survived into the modern age. They range from colossal eagles to spiked reptiles. They are the living remnants of a time when the world was younger and more savage. Abilities: Colossal Might: Ignores physical resistance, Roar of the Ancients: Stuns enemies with its volume

monsters.name: Lightning-Wurm
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A long, serpentine creature with twelve muscular legs and scales that shimmer with electric blue energy. It is a fierce rival of dragons and possesses the ability to discharge a massive bolt of lightning from its wide, toothy maw. Abilities: Lightning Discharge: Fires a line of electricity, Constrict: Squeezes the life out of a target

monsters.name: The Eye-Tyrant of the Void
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A floating orb of chitin and muscle, dominated by a massive central eye and a mouth filled with rows of serrated teeth. Ten smaller eyes sprout from its top on fleshy stalks, each capable of unleashing a different, terrifying magical effect. Abilities: Anti-Magic Gaze: Central eye suppresses all magic, Eye-Ray Volley: Stalks fire multiple magical beams at once

monsters.name: Ocular Sovereign (Elder Orb)
monsters.description: Type: Eldritch Horror. Ancient and exceptionally powerful ocular sovereigns that have lived for centuries and are master spellcasters. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Arcane Mastery, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular Sovereign and ocular-kin
monsters.description: Type: Eldritch Horror. A general category for ocular sovereigns and their various related species. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular Sovereign Mage
monsters.description: Type: Generic Creature. A prestige class for ocular sovereigns who have blinded their central eye to gain arcane spellcasting abilities. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Arcane Mastery, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular Sovereign, aquatic
monsters.description: Type: Eldritch Horror. Deep-sea ocular-kin with lobster-like claws and a spherical body, also known as the Eye of the Deep. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Natural Weaponry, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular Sovereign, Death Tyrant
monsters.description: Type: Necrotic Being. Undead ocular sovereigns appearing as hovering skulls with spectral eyes and negative energy cones. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Life Drain, Immunity to Fear, Aerial Maneuverability, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular Sovereign, Undead
monsters.description: Type: Necrotic Being. A general term for any ocular sovereign that has been raised from the dead, including death tyrants. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Life Drain, Immunity to Fear, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular-Kin
monsters.description: Type: Eldritch Horror. Reviewer Alex Lucard counted the ocular-kin among the "cool monsters" in MC7. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular-Kin (Death Kiss)
monsters.description: Type: Necrotic Being. Ocular-Kin with ten bloodsucking tentacles instead of a mouth or magical rays. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Life Drain, Immunity to Fear, Arcane Mastery, Blinding Flash, Sanguine Consumption

monsters.name: Ocular-Kin
monsters.description: Type: Eldritch Horror. A general category for creatures related to ocular sovereigns. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular-Kin, Death Kiss
monsters.description: Type: Necrotic Being. Ocular-Kin with ten bloodsucking tentacles instead of a mouth or magical rays. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Life Drain, Immunity to Fear, Arcane Mastery, Blinding Flash, Sanguine Consumption

monsters.name: Ocular-Kin, Eyeball
monsters.description: Type: Eldritch Horror. Tiny, four-eyed ocular-kin that serve as scouts or familiars for more powerful ocular sovereigns. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular-Kin, Gouger
monsters.description: Type: Eldritch Horror. Multi-eyed aberrations created to hunt other ocular sovereigns by gouging out their eyes with a barbed tongue. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Ocular Sovereigns
monsters.description: Type: Eldritch Horror. Aberration | A "creature that looks at you and is destroying you by the power of its magical eyes". Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Arcane Mastery, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Belabra (Tangler)
monsters.description: Type: Wild Animal. Flying jellyfish-like creatures from forest environments. Abilities: Aerial Maneuverability, Corrosive Secretions, Inorganic Resilience, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Belgoi
monsters.description: Type: Generic Creature. Belgoi appear human, but with long claws, toothless mouths, and webbed feet. Abilities: Natural Weaponry, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Belker
monsters.description: Type: Planar Entity. Evil air elemental that resemble a demon in the form of smoke. Abilities: Aerial Maneuverability, Natural Weaponry, Inorganic Resilience, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Berbalang
monsters.description: Type: Planar Entity. Medium-sized blue demon-like humanoid with bat wings. Abilities: Aerial Maneuverability, Natural Weaponry, Inorganic Resilience, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Berserker
monsters.description: Type: Wild Animal. Berserkers are based on the berserkir, "men of Odin, whom the god made strong like wild beasts", from Icelandic sagas and Snorri Sturluson's history of the kings of Norway. Abilities: Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bezekira (Hellcat)
monsters.description: Type: Wild Animal. Invisible, tiger-sized felines from the the Infernal Pits. Abilities: Inorganic Resilience, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bhaergala
monsters.description: Type: Wild Animal. Magical beasts obsessed with music. Abilities: Arcane Mastery, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bhuka
monsters.description: Type: Generic Creature. Peaceful desert-dwelling goblinoids with sand-colored skin and neck frills for heat regulation. Abilities: Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bhut
monsters.description: Type: Necrotic Being. Undead spirits that appear human by day and transform into scaly. Abilities: Multi-Directional Gaze, Energy Beams, Life Drain, Immunity to Fear, Natural Weaponry, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bi-nou
monsters.description: Type: Generic Creature. Stalagmite-like creatures with rocky skin that use bat-like sonar to perceive their surroundings in caverns. Abilities: Inorganic Resilience, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bichir (Lungfish, Giant)
monsters.description: Type: Wild Animal. Massive fish with lung-like organs that allow them to survive in stagnant water and move across land. Abilities: Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bionoid
monsters.description: Type: Artificial Life. Biomechanical constructs from the Void-Vessel setting, designed as "living weapons" with a powerful combat form. Abilities: Arcane Mastery, Inorganic Resilience, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bird
monsters.description: Type: Wild Animal. A general category for normal and giant birds common across the planes. Abilities: Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Birthright
monsters.description: Type: Generic Creature. A campaign setting focused on the struggle for power and leadership among noble bloodlines. Abilities: Blinding Flash, Sanguine Consumption

monsters.name: Bisan
monsters.description: Type: Nature Spirit. Fey connected to a tree that can transform into flying insects, such as honey bees or fruit flies. Abilities: Aerial Maneuverability, Arcane Mastery, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bison
monsters.description: Type: Wild Animal. Large, powerful herd animals common in plains and savannahs. Abilities: Inorganic Resilience, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Bitterstrike
monsters.description: Type: Planar Entity. A young white dragon from the the Northern Valleys known for its leadership over treants and frost witches. Abilities: Aerial Maneuverability, Natural Weaponry, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Black Bear
monsters.description: Type: Wild Animal. Type: Beast. Abilities: Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Black Cloud of Vengeance
monsters.description: Type: Necrotic Being. A malevolent, storm-like entity created by the wrath of a deity or a powerful spirit. Abilities: Aerial Maneuverability, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Black Earth Cultists

monsters.name: Feline Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Self-willed animated remains of cats that return from the grave to seek vengeance. Abilities: Pounce, Stealth, Bite

monsters.name: Sky-Hunter
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Intelligent winged felines. Abilities: Pounce, Stealth, Bite

monsters.name: Feline Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A horrific. Abilities: Pounce, Stealth, Bite

monsters.name: Feline Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Humanoids with feline features. Abilities: Pounce, Stealth, Bite

monsters.name: Feline Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. David M. Abilities: Pounce, Stealth, Bite

monsters.name: Feline Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Large predatory cats. Abilities: Pounce, Stealth, Bite

monsters.name: Feline Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Lawrence Schick described the stench kow as "a monstrous bison that smells real bad". Abilities: Pounce, Stealth, Bite

monsters.name: Cavern Saurian
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A rare and dangerous creature known as the Cavern Saurian.. Abilities: Stone Camouflage, Crushing Tail

monsters.name: Cavern Angler
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Large. Abilities: Sticky Filament, Pincer Snap

monsters.name: Cavern Angler
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A large insectoid with characteristics of a spider and lobster. Abilities: Sticky Filament, Pincer Snap

monsters.name: Stone-Grasshopper
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Giant mottled-gray grasshoppers with effective stony camouflage. Abilities: Sonic Leap, Swarm Attack

monsters.name: Underdark Hound
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Small. Abilities: Bat-Ears, Blind-Senses

monsters.name: Tiger-Striped Skink
monsters.description: Type: Tiny Reptile. A miniature, highly intelligent lizard standing barely a foot tall, covered in vibrant orange and black stripes. These creatures are known for their inquisitive nature and ability to mimic simple sounds. Abilities: Echo Mimicry: Can repeat short phrases or sounds perfectly, Camouflage: Blends into foliage with remarkable ease.

monsters.name: Aura Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Celestial Entity. A shimmering manifestation of pure virtue, radiating a soft golden light that calms the weary. These entities appear as translucent, humanoid figures with magnificent wings of woven starlight. Abilities: Soothing Radiance: Heals nearby allies over time, Divine Shield: Creates a barrier of light to block incoming strikes.

monsters.name: Blessed Beast
monsters.description: Type: Enchanted Animal. Ordinary woodland creatures that have been touched by a divine spark, granting them golden fur and a noble bearing. They act as protectors of sacred groves and are fiercely loyal to those who show kindness. Abilities: Purifying Strike: Attacks deal additional holy damage, Noble Grace: Inspires courage in those around them.

monsters.name: Hallowed Kin
monsters.description: Type: Group. A collective of diverse creatures unified by a shared celestial origin, often seen traveling in packs through the upper planes. They exhibit a collective intelligence and coordinate their efforts with supernatural precision. Abilities: Shared Essence: Buffs applied to one member are shared with others, Synchronized Assault: Gains strength when attacking the same target.

monsters.name: Lions of the Firmament
monsters.description: Type: Winged Sage. Massive, lion-like beings with wise, human-like expressions and expansive feathered wings of pure white. They are the keepers of ancient lore and guard the gateways to the highest heavens. Abilities: Astral Roar: Disorients foes with a thunderous sound, Sage's Insight: Can predict an opponent's next move.

monsters.name: Equine-Kin Strider
monsters.description: Type: Hybrid. Powerful beings with the upper body of a muscular human and the lower body of a majestic horse. They are the traditional guardians of the deep woods, living in tight-knit nomadic tribes. Abilities: Galloping Charge: Increases damage when moving in a straight line, Multi-Weapon Mastery: Can use bows and spears with equal proficiency.

monsters.name: Desiccated Galloper
monsters.description: Type: Undead Hybrid. The preserved, leathery remains of a centaur, bound together by ancient funerary wraps and necrotic energy. They wander the desert ruins, their hollow eyes glowing with a malevolent, unliving hunger. Abilities: Rotting Hooves: Attacks can cause a lingering decay, Sand-Storm Veil: Can disappear into a localized cloud of dust.

monsters.name: Plateau Centaur
monsters.description: Type: Majestic Hybrid. Large and imposing, these hybrids possess shimmering, iridescent scales along their equine bodies and long, braided hair. They are master navigators of the high plateaus and are known for their pride. Abilities: Iridescent Glare: Briefly blinds opponents with reflected light, Superior Stamina: Can travel long distances without tiring.

monsters.name: Crystal-Lake Galloper
monsters.description: Type: Sylvan Hybrid. Leaner and more agile than their cousins, these centaurs have coats that shimmer like the surface of a clear mountain lake. They are reclusive and shy, preferring the solitude of the high altitudes. Abilities: Water-Sprint: Can run across the surface of calm water, Mist-Step: Can teleport short distances through fog.

monsters.name: Mirage Wanderer
monsters.description: Type: Nomadic Hybrid. Known as the "Shadows of the Dunes," these centaurs have skin and fur the color of sun-bleached bone. They move with an eerie silence, appearing and disappearing like heat mirages. Abilities: Heat-Haze Camouflage: Becomes nearly invisible in extreme heat, Thirst-Resistance: Can survive for weeks without water.

monsters.name: Shadow-Hoof Brute
monsters.description: Type: Savage Hybrid. The most brutal of the hybrid tribes, possessing shaggy, unkempt coats of charcoal and brown. They are known for their immense strength and a culture centered around martial dominance. Abilities: Berserker Rage: Increases strength at the cost of defense, Bone-Crushing Kick: A powerful rear kick that can shatter stone.

monsters.name: Grove Sentinel
monsters.description: Type: Tribal Hybrid. A peaceful and sociable creature that integrates seamlessly into the forest ecosystem. They have the upper body of a lithe human and the lower body of a dappled deer or small horse. Abilities: Nature's Bond: Can communicate with local flora and fauna, Herbal Healing: Knows the secrets of forest medicine.

monsters.name: Bone-Spurred Pony-Kin
monsters.description: Type: Armored Hybrid. A smaller, stockier race of centaur-kin characterized by natural bony plates protruding from their joints and ribs. They are tough as iron and perfectly adapted to the thick undergrowth of the jungle. Abilities: Natural Plating: High resistance to physical attacks, Spiked Shoulder: Deals damage to attackers when grappling.

monsters.name: Goat-Legged Satyr
monsters.description: Type: Hybrid-Kin. Agile mountaineers with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a mountain goat. They are expert climbers and often serve as guides through treacherous alpine terrain. Abilities: Sure-Footed: Never loses balance on narrow ledges, Horn-Butt: A forceful head-on collision.

monsters.name: Stubborn Hoof-Man
monsters.description: Type: Hybrid-Kin. A sturdy race known for their Incredible persistence and resilience, possessing the lower body of a donkey. They are the builders and laborers of the hybrid-kin world. Abilities: Unyielding Will: Immune to fear and charm effects, Burden-Bearer: Can carry massive weights without effort.

monsters.name: Pony-Loper
monsters.description: Type: Hybrid-Kin. A small and friendly race with the lower body of a pony, known for their love of games and music. They often live near human settlements and act as messengers. Abilities: Joyful Dance: Boosts the morale of nearby allies, Quick-Step: Exceptional evasion skills.

monsters.name: Striped Nomad
monsters.description: Type: Hybrid-Kin. Striking creatures with the lower body of a zebra, perfectly camouflaged for the tall grasses of the open plains. They are nomadic hunters with a deep connection to the cycle of the seasons. Abilities: Dazzle-Pattern: Confuses predators when moving in a group, Long-Strider: Can outrun most savanna predators.

monsters.name: Hoofed War-Host
monsters.description: Type: Warriors. A disciplined military unit of centaurs, trained to coordinate their human and equine halves in perfect unison. They are a formidable force on any battlefield. Abilities: Dual-Strike: Can attack with a weapon and hooves in the same turn, Trampling Charge: Knocks down smaller opponents.

monsters.name: Vermilion Crawler
monsters.description: Type: Giant Vermin. A bright red, many-legged insectoid that grows to over a foot in length. They are aggressive scavengers that inhabit the damp corners of deep dungeons. Abilities: Venomous Bite: Causes paralysis in small prey, Chitinous Armor: Protective outer shell.

monsters.name: Great Carapace Crawler
monsters.description: Type: Colossal Insect. A massive, armored centipede the size of a wagon, with mandibles capable of snapping iron. They dwell in the deepest trenches of the earth, waiting for vibrations from above. Abilities: Crushing Coils: Constricts and crushes opponents, Acidic Spray: Shoots a stream of digestive enzymes.

monsters.name: Savage Scuttler
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A mutated, more aggressive version of the giant centipede, characterized by jagged spikes along its back and a constant, clicking hiss. Abilities: Spiked Carapace: Damages anything that touches it, Rapid Scurry: Can climb walls and ceilings at high speed.

monsters.name: Ethereal Myriapod
monsters.description: Type: Spirit. A ghostly, translucent centipede that drifts through the air like a ribbon of smoke. It exists between the physical and spiritual planes, feeding on the essence of the departed. Abilities: Phase-Shift: Can pass through solid objects, Essence Drain: Saps the energy of living beings it passes through.

monsters.name: Era-Sleeper
monsters.description: Type: Colossal Annelid. A gargantuan subterranean worm that sleeps for centuries, its body becoming part of the geological landscape. When it awakens, its hunger is enough to swallow entire villages. Abilities: Earth-Shaking Roar: Causes localized earthquakes, Burrowing Maw: Can eat through solid rock with ease.

monsters.name: Mind-Leech Microbes
monsters.description: Type: Organism. Invisible, microscopic organisms that thrive in areas of high mental energy. They attach to the psychic signatures of living beings, slowly draining their willpower and memory. Abilities: Psionic Siphon: Drains mana or mental focus, Cognitive Fog: Causes confusion and memory loss.

monsters.name: Thought-Devourer Demon
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A towering, eight-foot humanoid demon with an exposed, pulsating brain-like head. They are the torturers of the psychic realms, feeding on the intellect and secrets of their victims. Abilities: Mind-Blast: An explosion of psychic pain, Intellect Devour: Permanently lowers a target's intelligence.

monsters.name: Hollow-Shell Terrapin
monsters.description: Type: Reptile. A large desert tortoise with a shell full of strange, hollow protrusions. When the wind blows through these holes, it creates a haunting, whistling sound that can lure or terrify. Abilities: Resonating Shell: Can produce sounds that mimic voices, Iron-Guard: Withdraws into its shell for near-invulnerability.

monsters.name: River-Jaguar Fey
monsters.description: Type: Water Spirit. A slender, emerald-eyed jaguar with fur that flows like liquid water. These fey are the guardians of jungle waterways, appearing as mist before solidifying into their predatory form. Abilities: Water-Leap: Can lunge from any body of water, Drowning Gaze: Causes a target to feel as if they are underwater.

monsters.name: Iron-Link Construct
monsters.description: Type: Automaton. A hulking mass of heavy, rusted chains magically animated into a vaguely humanoid shape. It moves with a constant, grinding clatter and is often used as a tireless guardian. Abilities: Binding Lash: Snags and pulls enemies close, Chain-Whirl: A devastating spinning attack.

monsters.name: Fungal High-Steward
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A bloated, rotting entity made of fungus and moss, grown over the remains of a fallen warrior. They serve the ancient powers of decay, spreading spores wherever they tread. Abilities: Spore-Cloud: Releases a gas that causes fungal growth in lungs, Rotting Touch: Rapidly decays organic matter.

monsters.name: Prism-Skin Beast
monsters.description: Type: Adaptive Predator. A lizard-like predator with skin that shifts through the entire color spectrum to match its surroundings perfectly. It is the ultimate ambush hunter of the wildlands. Abilities: Chromatic Veil: Perfect invisibility when stationary, Reactive Scales: Changes resistance based on the last type of damage taken.

monsters.name: Speckled Scaler
monsters.description: Type: Reptilian Humanoid. Tall, spindly humanoids with skin that can change color but usually remains a dappled green and brown. They are expert climbers and live in elaborate tree-top villages. Abilities: Prehensile Tail: Can be used to hold weapons or climb, Adaptive Camouflage: Grants a bonus to stealth in any environment.

monsters.name: Hidden One
monsters.description: Type: Stalker. A legendary variant of the speckled scaler known for its absolute mastery of stealth. They are the elite assassins and scouts of the jungle tribes. Abilities: Silent Strike: Critical hits deal massive extra damage when attacking from stealth, Shadow-Blend: Can hide even in plain sight.

monsters.name: Legendary Vanquisher
monsters.description: Type: Warrior. A paragon of martial prowess, these warriors have surpassed the limits of mortal skill. They are often found at the center of world-changing events, wielding weapons of legend. Abilities: Unstoppable Force: Immune to crowd control for a short duration, Finishing Blow: Deals massive damage to low-health targets.

monsters.name: Veneer-Shifter
monsters.description: Type: Shapechanger. A mysterious individual capable of altering their physical appearance to mimic any humanoid they have seen. In their natural state, they are pale and featureless, like an unfinished sculpture. Abilities: Perfect Mimicry: Can copy voice and appearance exactly, Persona-Mask: Can hide their true alignment and thoughts.

monsters.name: Entropy Muck
monsters.description: Type: Formless Being. A shifting mass of raw chaos that defies logic and physical laws. It has no fixed form, constantly sprouting limbs, eyes, and maws that melt back into its bubbling core. Abilities: Chaotic Mutation: Gains a random ability every few minutes, Formless Strike: Attacks can pass through armor.

monsters.name: Shifting Amalgam
monsters.description: Type: Abomination. A horrific creature from the spaces between worlds, consisting of a jumbled mess of mismatched parts from dozens of different species. Abilities: Assimilate: Can absorb dead creatures to grow larger, Void-Pulse: A wave of energy that disrupts magical effects.

monsters.name: Anarchy Sprite
monsters.description: Type: Mischievous Fiend. A tiny, red-skinned imp with a chaotic energy that causes minor reality glitches wherever it goes. They love nothing more than causing confusion and minor catastrophes. Abilities: Reality-Glitch: Causes an enemy's weapon to temporarily turn into something harmless, Blink-Step: Constantly teleports small distances.

monsters.name: Prismatic Storm-Bird
monsters.description: Type: Colossal Avian. A bird of prey the size of a ship, with feathers that shimmer with all the colors of a rainbow. Its wingspan is large enough to block out the sun, and its cry sounds like a thunderclap. Abilities: Rainbow-Gust: Blasts enemies with multi-elemental energy, Sky-Sovereign: Can command the weather within a mile.

monsters.name: Mass-Grave Behemoth
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A horrific giant constructed from hundreds of fused corpses, held together by iron spikes and dark necromancy. It is a walking monument to the horrors of war. Abilities: Corpse-Toss: Throws explosive, rotting bodies at foes, Grave-Pull: Dead bodies on the ground grasp at the feet of enemies.

monsters.name: Abyssal Drone-Fly
monsters.description: Type: Demon. A human-sized, fly-like demon with four translucent wings and a long, needle-like proboscis. The constant droning of its wings can drive mortals to madness. Abilities: Soporific Drone: Puts nearby creatures to sleep, Siphon-Sting: Drains blood to heal itself.

monsters.name: Void-Rodent Bandit
monsters.description: Type: Mammal. Small, intelligent mammals that resemble raccoons but with six legs and the ability to survive in the vacuum of space. They are notorious for stealing shiny objects and sabotaging ship machinery. Abilities: Gravity-Leap: Can jump incredible distances in low gravity, Tech-Sabotage: Can disable mechanical devices.

monsters.name: Quick-Strike Prowler
monsters.description: Type: Feline. A lithe, long-legged cat with a spotted coat, engineered by nature for extreme bursts of speed. They are the fastest land predators in the known world. Abilities: Flash-Sprint: Moves at quadruple speed for a short burst, Precise Jugular-Bite: A lethal strike to the throat.

monsters.name: Psionic Dune-Crab
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A large, chitinous creature with multiple spindly legs and a transparent shell through which its glowing, psionic brain is visible. It waits under the sand to ambush the minds of travelers. Abilities: Psychic Trap: Lures prey with mental illusions of water, Neural Spike: A direct attack on the target's central nervous system.

monsters.name: Luring Spider-Mimic
monsters.description: Type: Vermin. A strange arachnid with a body that can reshape itself to look like an injured animal or even a small child. It uses this mimicry to lure compassionate souls into its sticky webs. Abilities: Voice-Echo: Mimics sounds perfectly, Paralytic Silk: Webs that freeze the victim in place.

monsters.name: Hoof-Shield Fey
monsters.description: Type: Fey. A mystical protector of equines, appearing as a noble human with the ears and tail of a horse. They are sworn to protect all four-legged herbivores from harm. Abilities: Equine-Summon: Can call wild horses to its aid, Shield-Aura: Protects nearby animals from all damage.

monsters.name: Bearded Stream-Serpent
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A long, serpentine dragon with iridescent scales and a flowing, multicolored beard that resembles waterweed. It is the benevolent spirit of a specific river. Abilities: Torrent-Breath: A powerful blast of high-pressure water, Current-Control: Can speed up or slow down the flow of a river.

monsters.name: Web-Footed Cloud-Eel
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A wingless, serpentine dragon with large, webbed feet and a body that seems to float effortlessly through both water and air. They are noble and often very old. Abilities: Cloud-Walk: Can walk on air as if it were solid ground, Wisdom of the Depths: Grants a buff to intelligence to those it favors.

monsters.name: Rime-Shell Horror
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A creature of translucent, ever-freezing ice that radiates a cold so intense it can shatter steel. It moves with a jagged, unsettling rhythm. Abilities: Flash-Freeze: Instantly turns moisture in the air to ice, Frost-Armor: Reflects cold damage back at the attacker.

monsters.name: Salt-Blood Kin
monsters.description: Type: Aquatic. A human-like race with pale, bluish skin and gills along their necks. They are the descendants of ancient unions between land-dwellers and sea spirits. Abilities: Deep-Breath: Can breathe both air and water, Pressure-Resistance: Immune to the effects of the deep ocean.

monsters.name: Three-Headed Hybrid
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A terrifying beast with the body of a lion, the wings of a dragon, and three heads: a lion, a goat, and a dragon. It is a creature of pure, unbridled destruction. Abilities: Triple-Bite: Three attacks in one action, Elemental Breath: Each head breathes a different element.

monsters.name: Amalgamate Beast
monsters.description: Type: Template. A creature that has been surgically and magically fused with parts from other animals. These chimeras are often the result of forbidden experiments by mad wizards. Abilities: Hybrid-Vigor: Increased health and strength, Grafted-Weaponry: Claws or stingers added to its original form.

monsters.name: Web-Weaver Serf
monsters.description: Type: Arachnid-Humanoid. Small, four-armed humanoids with spider-like features, including multiple eyes and the ability to produce silk. They are a subjugated race, often forced to work in the deep mines. Abilities: Multi-Arm Flurry: Can attack multiple times with small blades, Sticky Trap: Covers the floor in webbing.

monsters.name: Six-Armed Scuttler
monsters.description: Type: Spider-Kin. A larger, more combat-oriented variant of the web-weaver, possessing six powerful arms and a aggressive temperament. They roam the darkness in small, lethal packs. Abilities: Wall-Crawl: Can fight while hanging from the ceiling, Poison-Blade: Coats its weapons in its own venom.

monsters.name: Grasping Lurker
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A pale, rubbery humanoid with incredibly long, elastic limbs. It hangs from the ceilings of dark caverns, waiting for a victim to pass underneath so it can snatch them up. Abilities: Elastic Grab: Can reach out up to 30 feet to grab prey, Constrict: Strangles the target once caught.

monsters.name: Pale Brood-Mother
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A bloated, sickly-white creature that serves as the queen and priestess of the spider-kin colonies. She is surrounded by a constant swarm of her offspring. Abilities: Brood-Summon: Calls dozens of tiny spiders to distract foes, Web-Shield: A thick barrier of silk that blocks spells.

monsters.name: Warped Thrall
monsters.description: Type: Mutated Human. A human who has been subjected to horrific magical mutations, resulting in a distorted body and a shattered mind. They serve their creators with mindless obedience. Abilities: Pain-Ignorance: Does not flinch when taking damage, Mutated Growth: Can temporarily grow a new limb or weapon.

monsters.name: Spectral Sky-Ray
monsters.description: Type: Alien. A beautiful but alien creature that resembles a bluish-black manta ray made of light. It floats through the high atmosphere, feeding on sunlight and clouds. Abilities: Ethereal-Drift: Becomes intangible to avoid attacks, Sky-Flash: Emits a blinding burst of azure light.

monsters.name: Azure-Ice Elemental
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A hulking golem composed of ancient, deep-blue glacier ice. It is a slow-moving but nearly indestructible force of nature. Abilities: Freezing Aura: Slows nearby enemies, Glacial Slam: A heavy blow that can freeze the target solid.

monsters.name: Prismatic Scaled-Lords
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. Massive dragons of various colors, each representing a different elemental power. They are the top predators of the natural world and are often worshipped as gods. Abilities: Elemental Breath: A blast of fire, ice, acid, or lightning, Frightful Presence: Causes enemies to flee in terror.

monsters.name: Temporal Bloom
monsters.description: Type: Sentient Plant. An immense, glowing flower whose petals shift in and out of existence. Its nectar is a powerful substance that can grant visions of the future or memories of the forgotten past. Abilities: Time-Stop Pollen: Briefly freezes everything in a small area, Vision-Cloud: Confuses enemies with hallucinations of their own past.

monsters.name: Steel-Feathered Sage
monsters.description: Type: Intelligent Avian. Highly intelligent birds with feathers made of a shimmering, metallic alloy. They are the chroniclers of the celestial realms and possess vast knowledge of the cosmos. Abilities: Metallic Flight: Wings act as sharp blades in flight, Chrono-Vision: Can see a few seconds into the future.

monsters.name: Time-Dilation Jelly
monsters.description: Type: Organism. A floating, ovoid blob of gelatinous matter that distorts the flow of time around it. It is a communal organism that lives in the rifts between eras. Abilities: Slow-Field: Everything near the jelly moves at half speed, Time-Erosion: Causes equipment to age and break rapidly.

monsters.name: Mist-Bound Wanderer
monsters.description: Type: Ghost. The legless, floating spirit of one who died without a clear destination in the afterlife. They wander the borderlands, searching for a path they can no longer find. Abilities: Soul-Touch: Passes through armor to damage the soul, Fog-Shroud: Creates a thick mist that hides its movement.

monsters.name: Ethereal Pincer-Worm
monsters.description: Type: Worm. A gargantuan, translucent worm with two massive, ghost-like pincers. It hunts the spirits of the dead in the ethereal plane, dragging them into the void. Abilities: Ethereal Breach: Can pull physical objects into the spirit realm, Spirit-Sunder: Attacks deal extra damage to incorporeal beings.

monsters.name: Order of Eternal Night
monsters.description: Type: Cultists. A secretive network of nihilistic individuals dedicated to the concept of absolute nothingness. They operate in the shadows, working to extinguish the light of the world. Abilities: Shadow-Mantle: Can disappear into any shadow, Void-Prayer: A chant that drains the hope and stamina of enemies.

monsters.name: Carapace Slasher
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A horrific hybrid of a crustacean and a predatory insect, with the sleek tail of a serpent. It inhabits the murky waters of swamps and coastal caves. Abilities: Pincer-Snap: Can sever limbs with a single well-placed strike, Toxic Spray: Emits a cloud of blinding ink.

monsters.name: Leg-Mass Terror
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A writhing, nauseating mass of hundreds of long, hairy spider legs with no visible head or body. It moves with an unsettling, skittering speed. Abilities: Leg-Wrap: Dozens of legs grab and hold multiple targets, Psychic Static: Its presence causes a buzzing in the mind that prevents spellcasting.

monsters.name: Masked Nature-Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A tiny, doll-like spirit with a wooden mask, appearing only in the most pristine natural environments. They are curious and playful, often helping travelers they find interesting. Abilities: Nature's Gift: Can create a small amount of food or clean water, Elemental-Bond: Can command a small piece of the environment to move.

monsters.name: Spider-Scorpion Hybrid
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A large, multi-legged horror with the front half of a giant spider and the stinging tail of a scorpion. It is a relentless predator that never stops tracking its prey. Abilities: Dual-Venom: A bite that paralyzes and a sting that burns, Web-Lash: Uses its tail to throw sticky webbing.

monsters.name: Single-Eyed Desert-Crawler
monsters.description: Type: Vermin. An enormous, centipede-like creature with a single, massive compound eye at the center of its head. It can see through the thickest sandstorms with perfect clarity. Abilities: Optical-Beam: Fires a ray of concentrated heat from its eye, Sand-Swim: Can move through sand as if it were water.

monsters.name: Spark-Flight Horde
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A cohesive, flying mass of thousands of tiny fire spirits that look like floating embers. Together, they form a single, burning consciousness. Abilities: Incinerating Swarm: Deals fire damage to anything it passes through, Heat-Pulse: A wave of intense heat that melts weapons.

monsters.name: Blue-Flame Husk
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The charred, skeletal remains of fire elementals that have been brought back to a cold, unliving state. They smolder with a ghostly blue flame that drains heat rather than producing it. Abilities: Siphon-Warmth: Deals cold damage and heals itself, Ash-Cloud: Creates a cloud of choking, blinding soot.

monsters.name: Russet-Fur Trickster
monsters.description: Type: Mammal. A fox-like mammal with a deep, cinnamon-colored coat and a mischievous glint in its eyes. They are known for their cleverness and ability to lead pursuers into traps. Abilities: Illusion-Trail: Creates fake tracks and scents, Cunning Escape: Can slip out of any restraint or grapple.

monsters.name: Fluid-Drainer Annelid
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A giant, pale worm that inhabits urban water systems. It feeds on the vital fluids of its prey, but strangely excretes perfectly pure water, leading some cities to tolerate its presence. Abilities: Vital-Drain: Drains stamina and health from a target, Purifying Slime: Neutralizes poisons and diseases in its immediate area.

monsters.name: Crushing Pearl-Maw
monsters.description: Type: Bivalve. A massive, stationary clam that can grow to the size of a small house. It waits for large prey to wander inside its open shell before snapping shut with incredible force. Abilities: Instant-Snap: A reaction that catches anything entering its shell, Hardened Plate: Its shell is nearly impossible to penetrate.

monsters.name: Sanguine-Pike Tribe
monsters.description: Type: Horde. A brutal and aggressive tribe of warriors known for their red-stained spears and unrelenting ferocity. They believe that only the strong have the right to exist. Abilities: Blood-Rage: Gains power as more blood is spilled on the battlefield, Pike-Phalanx: Defensive formation that deals damage to attackers.

monsters.name: Severed Hand-Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A single, reanimated hand that skitters about on its fingers. While weak individually, they are often used as scouts, messengers, or a creepy distraction. Abilities: Fingertip-Climb: Can scale any surface, Grip-Choke: Can latch onto a throat and cause suffocation.

monsters.name: Mountain-Grip Hound
monsters.description: Type: Mammal. A sturdy, muscular dog with large, grasping paws and incredibly flexible limbs. They are the preferred companions for mountain-dwelling tribes. Abilities: Cliff-Leap: Can jump between vertical surfaces, Bark of Warning: Alerts allies to hidden threats.

monsters.name: Gliding Canopy-Ape
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A large predatory ape with flaps of skin between its limbs, allowing it to glide silently between the high trees of the jungle. Abilities: Aerial Ambush: Deals massive damage when attacking from a glide, Branch-Swing: Incredible mobility in forested areas.

monsters.name: Ceiling-Wrap Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A flat, leathery creature that looks like a tattered cloak or a patch of darkness on a cave ceiling. It drops onto unsuspecting prey, wrapping them in its suffocating folds. Abilities: Enveloping Grip: Suffocates and blinds the target, Shadow-Mimic: Becomes indistinguishable from a normal shadow.

monsters.name: Umbral Arch-Lurker
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. The ancient and powerful leaders of the stalker colonies, possessing high intelligence and the ability to manipulate the shadows themselves. Abilities: Shadow-Puppetry: Can control an enemy's movements by manipulating their shadow, Subsonic Dirge: A low-frequency moan that causes fear.

monsters.name: Luminous Symbiont
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A rare, benevolent variant of the stalker that glows with a soft, pulsing light. They attach themselves to willing hosts, providing light and healing in exchange for nutrients. Abilities: Healing-Pulse: Regularly restores health to its host, Dazzling Burst: Blinds attackers with a sudden flash of light.

monsters.name: Eclipse Parasite
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A sinister creature from the shadow realm that feeds on the life force of its victims by attaching itself to their physical shadow. Abilities: Shadow-Drain: Lowers the target's physical strength over time, Dark-Step: Can teleport between shadows.

monsters.name: Ancient Shade-Master
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Immensely old and powerful entities that rule over vast subterranean empires. They have total mastery over darkness and can summon shadows to do their bidding. Abilities: Night-Aura: Extinguishes all non-magical light sources, Shadow-Clone: Creates multiple illusory copies of itself.

monsters.name: Rigor-Mortis Wrap
monsters.description: Type: Undead. An undead variant of the ceiling stalker, combining its natural ambush tactics with the chill and resilience of the grave. Abilities: Icy Embrace: Deals cold damage to anyone it wraps, Undeath-Toughness: Resistant to non-magical weapons.

monsters.name: Gear-Bug Cleaner
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A small, mechanical insect created to keep the brass halls of great clockwork cities clean and free of rust. They are harmless but very persistent. Abilities: Rust-Removal: Can clean any metallic object, Mechanical-Sense: Can detect nearby machinery or traps.

monsters.name: Ticking Metallic Terror
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A highly advanced mechanical warrior made of precious metals and powered by complex clockwork. They are the ultimate guardians of the ancient artificers. Abilities: Rapid-Strike: Attacks twice with integrated blades, Self-Repair: Can fix its own damage during combat.

monsters.name: Spring-Wing Repairer
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Small, bird-like mechanical constructs that fly through the gears of the city, performing maintenance and repairs on the fly. Abilities: Precise Repair: Can heal other constructs, Aerial Maintenance: Can fix flying machines mid-flight.

monsters.name: Iron-Plate Stallion
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A mechanical horse made of interlocking metal plates and powerful springs. They are used as tireless mounts for wealthy travelers and knights. Abilities: Unyielding Gallop: Can travel at full speed indefinitely, Trampling Hooves: Heavy metal hooves deal massive damage.

monsters.name: Animated Gear-Units
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A general category of mechanical constructs of all sizes, from tiny scouts to massive defenders, all unified by their gear-driven nature. Abilities: Collective-Mind: Constructs coordinate their actions perfectly, Modular-Design: Can be easily upgraded with new tools or weapons.

monsters.name: Storm-Drifting Giant
monsters.description: Type: Ray. A gargantuan, flat-bodied creature that floats through the upper atmosphere, feeding on lightning and storm clouds. They are feared by all who sail the skies. Abilities: Lightning-Lash: Strikes enemies with a whip of pure electricity, Cloud-Summon: Can hide itself in a sudden storm.

monsters.name: Ancient Doom-Tomes
monsters.description: Type: Cursed Artifacts. Ancient scrolls and books that contain knowledge so terrible it can drive the reader mad or summon horrific entities from the void. Abilities: Forbidden Knowledge: Grants power at the cost of sanity, Spirit-Summon: Can call forth a guardian from the tome's pages.

monsters.name: Great Hooded Serpent
monsters.description: Type: Serpent. A massive cobra that can reach twenty feet in length, with a hood that can expand to the size of a shield. Its venom is one of the most lethal substances in the natural world. Abilities: Lethal-Strike: A bite that can kill almost instantly, Hypnotic Sway: Lulls prey into a trance-like state.

monsters.name: Stone-Peck Avian
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A small, pheasant-like bird with a sharp, stone-tipped beak. Its touch can cause skin to harden and turn to solid rock. Abilities: Petrifying-Peck: Turns the target to stone on a successful hit, Evasive-Flight: Very difficult to hit while in the air.

monsters.name: Medusa-Birds
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Larger and more aggressive than the stone-peck avian, these birds hunt in packs, turning their prey into stone statues that they then slowly peck apart. Abilities: Pack-Petrifaction: Increases the speed of petrifaction when multiple birds attack, Stone-Shatter: Deals extra damage to petrified targets.

monsters.name: Mind-Linked Coral-Host
monsters.description: Type: Colony. A colony of sentient polyps that have built a vaguely humanoid body out of pieces of coral and shells. They share a single, collective consciousness and protect the reef. Abilities: Coral-Reconstruction: Can regrow lost limbs quickly, Psychic-Wall: A mental barrier that protects the reef from intruders.

monsters.name: Shallow-Grave Revenant
monsters.description: Type: Undead. An undead creature formed from a body that was improperly or hastily buried. It rises from the earth, driven by a desire for a proper rest or revenge on those who buried it. Abilities: Earth-Grasp: Can pull itself and others into the ground, Death-Chill: An aura of cold that reduces enemy movement.

monsters.name: Living Monument
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A massive statue of stone, flesh, or iron that has been animated by ancient magic to guard a specific location for eternity. Abilities: Colossal-Slam: A devastating attack that hits a wide area, Immovable-Object: Immune to all forms of displacement.

monsters.name: Glimmer-Pony
monsters.description: Type: Fey. A small, enchanted pony that can shift its size at will. They are the favored mounts of the small fey and are known for their playful, unpredictable nature. Abilities: Size-Shift: Can grow to the size of a warhorse or shrink to the size of a mouse, Rainbow-Trail: Leaves a trail of light that confuses pursuers.

monsters.name: Horned Shape-Stealer
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A tall, imposing fiend with two horns and the ability to take the form of any humanoid it has killed. They are cunning manipulators who enjoy sewing discord among mortals. Abilities: Face-Steal: Takes the form and memories of a victim, Demonic-Strength: Possesses the power of ten men.

monsters.name: Humble Folk
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Average person of any race. Abilities: Weapon mastery, Tactical coordination.

monsters.name: Spirit of the Unwed
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Ghosts of women who died young. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Equilibrium Arbiter
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Powerful planar neutral outsiders (Rilmani) that serve to maintain the balance of the multiverse. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Magma Sludge
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Large, sentient pools of liquid fire and magma from the Elemental Plane of Fire that incinerate anything they touch. Abilities: Elemental strike, Resistance to natural damage.

monsters.name: Novice Summoner
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A low-level spellcaster who is still learning the arcane arts, often serving a more powerful wizard. Abilities: Weapon mastery, Tactical coordination.

monsters.name: Starborn Entity
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Extraplanar entities composed of literal starlight and celestial patterns, often appearing as humanoid-shaped constellations. Abilities: Radiant burst, Healing touch, Divine shield.

monsters.name: Coiling Serpent
monsters.description: Type: Beast. . Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Floating Intellectual
monsters.description: Type: Giant. Highly intelligent aberrations that resemble giant, floating heads. Abilities: Rock throwing, Greatclub, Immense strength.

monsters.name: Clockwork Messenger
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Spider-like constructs made of copper plates and clockwork, often used as messengers or laboratory assistants by gnomes. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Living Reef Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Living, sentient organisms from the Underdark that can manipulate their physical form to defend their colony. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Archival Tome Golem
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A supernatural essence or classification, reference to the foundational books and modules of the advanced dungeons & dragons system. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Prismatic Parrot
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Brightly colored, multi-headed birds that resemble parrots. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Ghostly Beacon
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Small, ghostly lights that hover over the bodies of the recently deceased, often leading travelers into dangerous traps. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Reanimated Remains
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A supernatural essence or classification, template to be added to any nonundead, nonconstruct, nonplant corporeal creature. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Grave Bloom
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Giant, sentient flowers that grow on burial mounds and feed on the dead. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Massive Bone Collector
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Colossal undead constructs made of thousands of fused bodies. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Plague Rodent Swarm
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A swarm of undead rats that can overwhelm and consume the living. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Blighted Beast
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A supernatural essence or classification, template to be added to any corporeal creature that is not an outsider. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Abyssal Sludge
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Horrific oozes composed of necrotic sludge and rotting flesh, found in the deepest pits of the Abyss. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Eldritch Void Terror
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Eldritch entities from the Far Realm that defy mortal comprehension and spread madness through their mere presence. Abilities: Psychic blast, Tentacle lash, Mind warp.

monsters.name: Feathered Sky Serpent
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Celestial. Abilities: Radiant burst, Healing touch, Divine shield.

monsters.name: Radiant Solar Naga
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Naga that possess the ability to emit a blinding light and have an affinity for fire and sun magic. Abilities: Radiant burst, Healing touch, Divine shield.

monsters.name: Shore Crustacean
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Beast. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Colossal Beach Crab
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Large crustaceans known for their powerful claws and defensive shell, common in coastal waters. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Great Pincer Crab
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Large crustaceans known for their powerful claws and defensive shell, common in coastal waters. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Mutated Tide Crab
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Large crustaceans known for their powerful claws and defensive shell, common in coastal waters. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Crustacean Hybrid
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Humanoids with crab-like features, often described as agile and skilled hunters with a strong sense of community. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Mountain Silvercat
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Intelligent, silver-furred cats that live in high mountain crags. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Neural Rodent
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Rats modified by brain-eaters which show a "glowing brain". Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Brain-Link Swarm
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Ranked among the weakest monsters in the game by Scott Baird from Screen Rant. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Cephalopod Mummy
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Colossal, undead mummies that resemble massive, desiccated squids with humanoid faces. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Severed Grip
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Amputated hands given artificial magical life. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Undead Hand
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Undead. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Giant's Severed Visage
monsters.description: Type: Undead. High-level undead monstrosities created from the severed, mutated heads of giants. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Natural Wildling
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A supernatural essence or classification, a category for natural and giant animals found across the material plane. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Summoned Manifestation
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A supernatural essence or classification, a category for entities summoned through conjuration magic. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Sentient Mortal
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A supernatural essence or classification, a category for sentient beings with humanoid physiology. Abilities: Weapon mastery, Tactical coordination.

monsters.name: Primeval Crawler
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A supernatural essence or classification, a category for vermin, insects, and other primitive life forms. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Feral Abomination
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A supernatural essence or classification, a category for dangerous and magical beasts. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Extradimensional Being
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A supernatural essence or classification, a category for entities originating from planes other than the material plane. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Material Dweller
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A supernatural essence or classification, a category for entities native to the material plane. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Necrotic Reanimation
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A supernatural essence or classification, a category for entities animated by necrotic energy. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Blood Mist Wraith
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Vaporous, man-shaped undead that haunt mist-shrouded wetlands. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Shrine Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Small, benign spirits that inhabit specific holy sites, often serving as guardians or advisors. Abilities: Radiant burst, Healing touch, Divine shield.

monsters.name: River Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. . Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Primeval River King
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Massive amphibians known for their strength and territorial behavior, common in tropical regions. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Desert Reptilian Mount
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Large, flightless reptilian beasts from Athas. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Anarchic Hag
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Malicious relatives of hags from the Mystara setting. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Chaos Witch
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Malicious relatives of hags from the Mystara setting. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Shelled Desert Nomad
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Desert-dwelling monstrous humanoids with broad, tortoise-like shells covering their upper bodies. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Tidal Zealots
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Fanatical followers of Olhydra, the Princess of Evil Water, seeking to flood the world. Abilities: Elemental strike, Resistance to natural damage.

monsters.name: Gargantuan Shell-Beast
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Large crustaceans known for their powerful claws and defensive shell, common in coastal waters. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Arctic Winged Humanoid
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Bat-winged, furred humanoids from the Arctic regions of Mystara. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Melodic Ghost
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Powerful, incorporeal undead from Libris Mortis that use haunting music to ensnare victims and drain their life force. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Tomb Caretaker
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Dedicated undead caretakers from Al-Qadim tasked with maintaining and guarding the tombs of nobles. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Skeletal Tomb Guard
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Skeletal guardians of tombs that serve as passive protectors. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Positive Energy Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Undead. "Deathless" creatures powered by positive energy that serve as eternal protectors of holy resting places. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Crystal Stinger
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. . Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Prismatic Hive Mind
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Crystalline hive-entities from the Crystalmist Mountains. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Zealot Leader
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Humanoid. Abilities: Weapon mastery, Tactical coordination.

monsters.name: Dark Disciple
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Servants of dark powers. Abilities: Weapon mastery, Tactical coordination.

monsters.name: Six-Armed War-Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Kagonesti transformed into six-armed ferocious evil fighter. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Heat-Seeking Frostbound
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. The gelun is a creature that has to live in the desert to avoid completely freezing over into a block of ice. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Ill-Fated Wanderer
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Individuals who have been marked by a malevolent deity or powerful spirit, often suffering from supernatural misfortune. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Cursed Spectral Light
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Restless spirits of those who died under the weight of a powerful curse, appearing as glowing, spectral lights. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Eternal Exile
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A supernatural essence or classification, the curst had the distinction of being the first piece of publication with references to the immensely detailed forgotten realms setting. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Spectral Hunt Hound
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Spectral white hounds with glowing red ears associated with the Wild Hunt. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Augmented Survivor
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Advanced technological constructs from the Barrier Peaks, combining organic life with cybernetic enhancements and weapons. Abilities: Immutable form, Magic resistance, Slam attack.

monsters.name: One-Eyed Giant
monsters.description: Type: Giant. Giant. Abilities: Rock throwing, Greatclub, Immense strength.

monsters.name: Masked Sand-Dweller
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Descendants of the once-great civilization of Cynidicea, now living in masks and madness beneath the sands of the Lost City. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Forbidden Lore Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A collection of adventure modules for the Advanced Dungeons & Dragons game focusing on the Dave Arneson's Blackmoor setting. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Floating Glyph-Speaker
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. These "floating goat-men" are common within the fictional city of Sigil. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Madness Overlord
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Immortal lords of Xoriat, the Plane of Madness. Abilities: Psychic blast, Tentacle lash, Mind warp.

monsters.name: Marauding Raider Goblin
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Plundering goblins. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Abyssal Sea Terror
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Obyrith demon lord of water, sea-dwelling creatures, and secrets. Abilities: Hellfire, Telepathy, Infernal pact.

monsters.name: Psychic Pack Hunter
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Psionic predators from Athas that track prey through "psychic scent. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Mouth-Ridden Horror
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Ancient high-level horrors with grey, shifting skin that constantly bursts into new toothy maws. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Earthen Tyrant Genie
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Greedy and malicious genies from the Elemental Plane of Earth. Abilities: Elemental strike, Resistance to natural damage.

monsters.name: Orca-Kin Seafarer
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Humanoids descended from orca lycanthropes. Abilities: Bite, Claw, Keen senses.

monsters.name: Shadow-Touched Being
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A supernatural essence or classification, template. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Ragged Shadow Fey
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Small, furtive fey humanoids that wrap themselves in dark rags to protect their sensitive skin from light. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Nocturnal Hills Drake
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. Malicious drakes. Abilities: Breath weapon, Frightful presence, Tail swipe.

monsters.name: Shadowfell Dweller
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Small humanoids from the Shadowfell plane. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Gloaming Kin
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Described are the Dark Creeper and Dark Stalker. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Shadow Elder
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The elders and leaders of the Dark Creepers, appearing as tall, fair humanoids resembling grey-skinned elves. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Desolation Lord
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A campaign setting characterized by the harsh, desert world of Athas, where water is scarce and psionics are common. Abilities: Elemental strike, Resistance to natural damage.

monsters.name: Tentacled Iron-Bark
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Sentient, predatory trees with bark as hard as stone and branches like whip-like tentacles. Abilities: Entangle, Thorn whip, Photosynthesis.

monsters.name: Gloomy Sky Hunter
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Flying humanoids from Mystara with dark coloration. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Hooded Life-Drainer
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Incorporeal undead spirits from Mystara that appear as hooded figures. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Corrupted Bat-Horror
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Normal animals transformed by evil magic into black reptilian horrors with glowing red eyes. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Silent Vitality Thief
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Another name for the Dark-hood or rorphyr, a hooded undead spirit that drains vitality. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Abyssal Halo Spectre
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Undead spectres composed of absolute blackness surrounded by a multi-colored nimbus. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Corrupted Outcast Fey
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A Vistani outcast who is corrupted by Ravenloft's nature and twisted into absolute evil. Abilities: Weapon mastery, Tactical coordination.

monsters.name: Light-Averse Fey
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Small fey humanoids cursed by the Summer Queen to absorb light, which withers their flesh. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Forbidden Knowledge Echo
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A supernatural essence or classification, a rare category for forbidden or ancient knowledge concerning the darker aspects of the multiverse. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Stalactite Lurker
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Monstrosity. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Eye-Studded Tentacle Mass
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Horrific mass of dozens of black tentacles Studded with small eyes. Abilities: Standard attacks and unique traits.

monsters.name: Shadow Spider Aberration
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Sinister spider-like aberrations from the Plane of Shadow with eight long tentacles. Abilities: Necrotic touch, Life drain, Undead resilience.

monsters.name: Cattle-Slaying Flyer
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Flying humanoid flock-hunters that decimate herds of cattle. Abilities: Weapon mastery, Tactical coordination.

monsters.name: Paralyzing Dart-Lizard
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Small, pear-shaped lizards with long snouts that fire paralyzing fangs like darts. Abilities: Elemental strike, Resistance to natural damage.

monsters.name: Grave-Born Scavenger
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A massive vulture with rotting feathers and glowing eyes, born from necrotic energy. Abilities: Corrosive Vomit, Fearful Screech

monsters.name: Whirling Bladeling
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A humanoid figure made of interlocking blades that moves with deadly grace. Abilities: Blade Storm, Evasive Waltz

monsters.name: Abyssal Reaper
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A terrifying entity from the void, cloaked in shadows and wielding a scythe of pure darkness. Abilities: Soul Reap, Shadow Step

monsters.name: Soul Harvester
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A lesser but still lethal fiend that feeds on the final gasps of the dying. Abilities: Death Knell, Essence Drain

monsters.name: Dual-Headed Hound
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A two-headed canine with matted fur and a vicious temperament. Abilities: Double Bite, Infectious Saliva

monsters.name: Bicephalous Ravager
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A large, ugly hound with two heads, each driven by a thirst for blood. Abilities: Pack Tactics, Relentless Hunt

monsters.name: Dread Overlord
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A fallen warrior reanimated with dark purpose, clad in blackened plate armor. Abilities: Necrotic Strike, Command Undead

monsters.name: Vitality Parasite
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A translucent, amoeba-like entity that clings to the living to drain their life force. Abilities: Life Drain, Phasing

monsters.name: Spectral Siphon
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A shimmering, ghostly blob that hovers in cemeteries, seeking warmth to steal. Abilities: Energy Sap, Invisibility

monsters.name: Grisly Willow
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A weeping willow whose fruit resembles shrunken human heads. Abilities: Entangling Vines, Terrifying Fruit

monsters.name: Sanguine Mist
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A blood-red vaporous entity that haunts marshes, taking on a vaguely humanoid shape. Abilities: Blood Drain, Gaseous Form

monsters.name: Necro-Goliath
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A massive, gray-skinned juggernaut that serves as a general for undead armies. Abilities: Crushing Blow, Aura of Doom

monsters.name: Titan Serpent
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. An enormous snake, reaching lengths of eighty feet, capable of crushing stone. Abilities: Constrict, Venomed Fangs

monsters.name: Skeletal Viper
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A flying serpent skeleton, animated by necromancy to strike from above. Abilities: Aerial Lunge, Bone Shard

monsters.name: Pact-Bound Shade
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The remains of a warlock whose soul is still tethered to an otherworldly patron. Abilities: Eldritch Blast, Patrons Curse

monsters.name: Cursed Arcanist
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A withered corpse that retains a fragment of its former magical power. Abilities: Wither Bolt, Spell Mimicry

monsters.name: Vengeful Stallion
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The ghost of a horse that died in agony, now seeking retribution against the living. Abilities: Phantom Gallop, Frightful Neigh

monsters.name: Floating Cranium
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A giant's severed head that moves by pulling itself along with its long, matted hair. Abilities: Bite, Hair Grab

monsters.name: Agony Banshee
monsters.description: Type: Undead. An incorporeal spirit that emits the collective screams of a lost city. Abilities: Mournful Wail, Psychic Shock

monsters.name: Desert Hyenoid
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A scavenger resembling a cross between a baboon and a hyena, native to arid wastes. Abilities: Pack Hunting, Bone-Crushing Jaw

monsters.name: Ten-Tentacled Spheroid
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A bizarre, round creature with ten long limbs used for climbing and ensnaring prey. Abilities: Multi-Limb Strike, Camouflage

monsters.name: Amphibious Decapod
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A versatile ten-limbed monster capable of hunting both in treetops and underwater. Abilities: Ink Cloud, Tentacle Grapple

monsters.name: Cavernous Serpent
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A slender, dark-scaled dragon adapted to the narrow tunnels of the deep earth. Abilities: Corrosive Breath, Shadow Meld

monsters.name: Scaly Glider
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A massive humanoid predator with leathery wings and protective horns, dwelling in deep caves. Abilities: Gliding Pounce, Horn Gore

monsters.name: Abyssal Shapeshifter
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A humanoid altered by deep-sea magic, able to transform into a fish-like predator. Abilities: Aquatic Form, Siren's Call

monsters.name: Monster Broodmother
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A horrific entity that creates copies of other creatures it has consumed. Abilities: Spawn Minion, Tentacle Flail

monsters.name: Forest Grazer
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A common woodland animal known for its speed and alertness. Abilities: Nimble Escape, Antler Ram

monsters.name: Identity Thief
monsters.description: Type: Undead. An undead horror that steals the faces of its victims, leaving them featureless. Abilities: Face Steal, Horrific Aspect

monsters.name: Sickle-Claw Raptor
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A swift, bipedal predator with a large, curved claw on each foot. Abilities: Pounce, Claw Frenzy

monsters.name: Cosmic Dolphin
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. An intelligent, friendly being that swims through the vacuum of space. Abilities: Astral Pathfinding, Joyful Leap

monsters.name: Oceanic Siren-Shark
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A predatory fish-like creature that sings beautiful, luring songs to its prey. Abilities: Luring Song, Swift Bite

monsters.name: Stone-Eater
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A massive creature that burrows through solid rock, consuming minerals as it goes. Abilities: Acid Slime, Tunneling

monsters.name: Jeweled Lizard
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A planar reptile whose skin is encrusted with glowing, valuable gemstones. Abilities: Gemstone Armor, Blinding Flash

monsters.name: Eternal Skull
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A jeweled skull that contains the powerful essence of an ancient wizard. Abilities: Trap the Soul, Howl

monsters.name: Tar-Skinned Jailer
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A thick-skinned fiend from a prison plane, specializing in keeping others bound. Abilities: Slime Spray, Unyielding Grip

monsters.name: Cursed Sentinels
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A collective of foul entities that police the lower planes of suffering. Abilities: Shared Bond, Infernal Discipline

monsters.name: Prince of Madness
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A two-headed titan of chaos, ruling over a domain of insanity. Abilities: Dual Gaze, Tentacle Strike

monsters.name: Chaos Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A generic but deadly entity born from the raw essence of the Abyss. Abilities: Teleport, Abyssal Strike

monsters.name: Four-Armed Archer
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A demon with four arms, allowing it to fire arrows with incredible speed. Abilities: Volley, Multi-Shot

monsters.name: Bull-Headed Juggernaut
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A massive, bovine-featured demon used as a heavy shock trooper. Abilities: Trample, Roar of Terror

monsters.name: Minotaur Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A colossal demonic bull that smashes through defenses with ease. Abilities: Gore, Mighty Swing

monsters.name: Despair Wing
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A bat-winged demon that embodies despair and feeds on mental anguish. Abilities: Aura of Despair, Shadow Claw

monsters.name: Handmaiden of Spiders
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A shapeshifting demon that can appear as a beautiful maid or a mass of ooze. Abilities: Web, Acid Spit

monsters.name: Abyssal Swarm-Host
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A collective of demonic insects that share a singular, malevolent will. Abilities: Swarm, Spore Spray

monsters.name: Void Marauders
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Legions of chaotic entities that seek only to destroy and consume. Abilities: Chaotic Surge, Endless Numbers

monsters.name: Infernal Categories
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A classification of the various horrors that dwell in the lightless pits. Abilities: Diversity of Forms, Unpredictable Nature

monsters.name: Arch-Fiends
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. The most powerful of their kind, each ruling a vast layer of eternal darkness. Abilities: Reality Warp, Command Fiends

monsters.name: Spiked Blood-Root
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A plant with thorny red stalks that spits infectious pods at intruders. Abilities: Spore Pod, Thorny Lash

monsters.name: Living Slab
