monsters.name: Subterranean Crusher
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Massive, beetle-like monstrosities that tunnel through solid rock and confuse prey with their gaze. Abilities: Confusing Gaze, Tunneling, Mandible Smash

monsters.name: Chitinous Mauler
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A humanoid insect with thick chitin and powerful claws, adapted for life deep underground. Abilities: Claw Multiattack, Burrow, Rock Smash

monsters.name: Mandible Burrowers
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Human-shaped creatures with gaping maws flanked by pairs of exceedingly sharp mandibles. Abilities: Tunneler, Sharp Mandibles, Tremorsense

monsters.name: Shadow Tree
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Sentient and malevolent trees from the Plane of Shadow that resemble massive banyans with bark like stone. Abilities: Shadow Entangle, Life Sap, Stone Bark

monsters.name: Void Sphere
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Colossal and terrifying aberrations that resemble a sphere of utter darkness, disintegrating all it touches. Abilities: Annihilating Touch, Hover, Void Aura

monsters.name: Shadow-Fused Beast
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A creature that has been fused with the essence of shadow, granting it stealth and necrotic power. Abilities: Shadow Stealth, Necrotic Strike, Frightful Presence

monsters.name: Gloom Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A creature warped by the Plane of Shadow, becoming a predator that strikes from the darkness. Abilities: Gloom Sight, Shadow Step, Hidden Strike

monsters.name: Static Shambler
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A hulking, wooly creature whose hair generates shocking levels of static electricity. Abilities: Static Shock, Shambling Slam, Wooly Defense

monsters.name: Mind Presence
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Incorporeal aberrations that have evolved beyond the physical body, existing only as a focused mental presence. Abilities: Psionic Blast, Incorporeal Movement, Mental Domination

monsters.name: Risen Corpse
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A generic term for any humanoid corpse that has been reanimated through dark magic or curses. Abilities: Undead Fortitude, Slam, Grave Chill

monsters.name: Stitch-Beast
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A horrific undead construct created by reanimating the remains of a chimera through necromancy. Abilities: Three-Headed Strike, Necrotic Breath, Rotting Claw

monsters.name: Revenant Hunter
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A spectral warrior bound by an oath to hunt dragons even after death. Abilities: Slayer's Strike, Dragon Dread, Ethereal Form

monsters.name: Crypt Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The remains of a dwarven warrior, still guarding their ancestral halls from beyond the grave. Abilities: Axe Strike, Stone Resilience, Dwarven Fortitude

monsters.name: Drowned Horror
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A massive aquatic creature that has been reanimated, haunting deep lakes and coastal waters. Abilities: Drowning Grip, Tail Sweep, Watery Grave

monsters.name: Star-Wraith
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Spectral entities and animated remains encountered within the void of space, feeding on starlight. Abilities: Star-Siphon, Void Drift, Cold Touch

monsters.name: Water Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Elemental spirits of pure water, often found in tranquil lakes and hidden springs. Abilities: Water Form, Drenching Wave, Liquid Strike

monsters.name: Spirit Ancestor
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The ancient and wise spirits of ancestors sustained by positive energy rather than necromancy. Abilities: Ancient Wisdom, Positive Burst, Spirit Counsel

monsters.name: Eternal Sentinel
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Noble and selfless warriors reanimated to serve as the eternal defenders of their homeland. Abilities: Eternal Guard, Holy Shield, Relentless Defense

monsters.name: Rhinoceros Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Large, quadrupedal outsiders from the Lower Planes that resemble a cross between a rhinoceros and a bull. Abilities: Fiendish Gore, Powerful Charge, Trample

monsters.name: Celestial Horn
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. A majestic horse-like celestial with a single spiraling horn, representing purity and healing. Abilities: Healing Touch, Teleport, Horn Thrust

monsters.name: Dark-Horned Beast
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A corrupted version of the celestial horn, representing decay and malice. Abilities: Corrupted Horn, Nightmare Charge, Dread Aura

monsters.name: Shadowsteed
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Reclusive and malevolent creatures that have been corrupted by the energy of the Shadowfell. Abilities: Shadow Step, Necrotic Horn, Gloom Sight

monsters.name: Mythic Chargers
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Powerful celestial steeds that can be ridden by those of pure heart, obeying their every command. Abilities: Divine Charge, Loyal Bond, Celestial Gallop

monsters.name: Reality Weaver
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Elemental spirits also known as menglis, capable of unraveling the fabric of reality. Abilities: Reality Warp, Weaver's Strike, Dimensional Rift

monsters.name: Planar Steed
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Horse-like creatures that move effortlessly from plane to plane, often carrying messages. Abilities: Planar Jump, Ethereal Gallop, Swift Messenger

monsters.name: Spiny Crawler
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Small, spiny fiends that infest the lower planes, striking with venomous quills. Abilities: Venomous Quills, Spiny Defense, Crawler Bite

monsters.name: Winged Kobold
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A subrace of kobolds that possess functional, leathery wings and a penchant for aerial bombardment. Abilities: Aerial Drop, Winged Maneuver, Dagger Strike

monsters.name: Stone-Shaper
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Rare humanoids with the innate ability to walk through stone and shape it with their hands. Abilities: Stone Walk, Earth Shape, Mason's Strike

monsters.name: Rat Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Rat-like demons from the Abyss that serve as primary scouts and spies for demonic lords. Abilities: Rat Swarm, Shadow Lurk, Plague Bite

monsters.name: Tentacled Stone
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A cross between a rocky outcropping and a psychic horror, possessing hidden, reaching tentacles. Abilities: Camouflage, Tentacle Snare, Mind Drain

monsters.name: Rocky Lurkers
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Ambush predators that look like rocky formations until they reveal their hidden tentacles. Abilities: False Appearance, Multiattack, Grasping Tentacles

monsters.name: Armored Polar Bear
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Massive, armored bear-like bipeds from the frozen north, possessing great strength and resolve. Abilities: Armored Charge, Maul, Cold Endurance

monsters.name: Shifting Shadows
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Elusive fey beings that can shift their forms and blend into the shadows of the forest. Abilities: Form Shift, Shadow Blend, Fey Charm

monsters.name: Tribal Spirit-Speaker
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. The spiritual leaders of barbarian tribes, capable of communing with animal spirits. Abilities: Spirit Calling, Tribal Chant, Animal Bond

monsters.name: Drought Bringer
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Large, bull-headed outsiders associated with drought and famine, turning fertile lands to dust. Abilities: Desiccating Touch, Drought Aura, Bull Rush

monsters.name: Cosmic Spider
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Gargantuan and terrifying aberrations that resemble a fusion of humanoid and spider, hailing from beyond. Abilities: Web Snare, Cosmic Insight, Multi-limb Strike

monsters.name: Bone-Crawler
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Creepy monstrosities that crawl through the remains of the dead, using bones as weapons. Abilities: Bone Strike, Scavenger's Hide, Creeping Crawl

monsters.name: Sky Sovereign
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Majestic beings of air and wind that rule over the clouds and keep the peace in the heavens. Abilities: Air Mastery, Sky Bolt, Cloud Form

monsters.name: Void Believer
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A sect of seekers who believe the multiverse is fundamentally empty, granting them a strange detachment. Abilities: Void Thought, Detached Gaze, Nihilistic Strike

monsters.name: Soul Collector
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Noble celestial warriors who choose the worthy slain and carry them to the afterlife. Abilities: Soul Reaping, Celestial Flight, Battle Cry

monsters.name: Battle Angels
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. Powerful female warriors of a divine pantheon, striking from the skies with holy light. Abilities: Holy Spear, Divine Shield, Aerial Strike

monsters.name: Hanged Vengeance
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A type of revenant, the animated body of one unjustly executed, seeking to prove their innocence. Abilities: Vengeful Noose, Hanged Cry, Undying Will

monsters.name: Ghoul Buccaneers
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Undead pirates that haunt the seas, led by captains and mages who hunger for life. Abilities: Blood Raid, Naval Tactics, Spectral Cutlass

monsters.name: Blood Noble
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Undead lords of the night who feed on the blood of the living and command the creatures of the dark. Abilities: Life Drain, Shapechange, Charm

monsters.name: Blood-Thirsty Bloom
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A malevolent plant with beautiful flowers that drain the blood of anyone who touches its thorns. Abilities: Blood Drain, Thorn Strike, Entangling Vines

monsters.name: Sanguine Flower
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A rare and dangerous flower found in ancient palaces, sustained by the blood of the unwary. Abilities: Sanguine Bloom, Sweet Scent, Draining Touch

monsters.name: Red Death Flowers
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Clumps of deadly roses that have overgrown ruined castles, thirsting for any living thing that passes. Abilities: Colony Strike, Blood Sucking, Needle Spray

monsters.name: Fledgling Bloodsucker
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Pale undead humanoids with sharp fangs, created by a greater blood noble to serve as thralls. Abilities: Claw, Bite, Spider Climb

monsters.name: Night Creeper
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Weakened versions of blood nobles that stalk the night, serving their masters with mindless loyalty. Abilities: Regeneration, Dark Stealth, Blood Bite

monsters.name: Mind-Sapper
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A rare variant of the undead that feeds on the mental energy and memories of its victims. Abilities: Memory Drain, Psychic Siphon, Mental Domination

monsters.name: Abyssal Nightshade
monsters.description: Type: Undead. These reclusive stalkers are former subterranean nobles who traded their souls for eternal life. They appear as gaunt, dark-skinned figures with glowing purple eyes, surrounded by a swirling aura of necrotic energy and cold mist. Abilities: Shadow Glide: Can move through solid shadows, Essence Drain: Saps life force with a touch, Necrotic Pulse: Releases a wave of dark energy.

monsters.name: Stone-Hearted Siphon
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A stocky, pale undead that haunts deep mountain veins. Its skin has the texture of cold marble, and it possesses the eerie ability to sink into solid rock, emerging only to feed on the breath of the living. Abilities: Earth Phase: Can walk through stone walls, Vitality Siphon: Drains the physical endurance of victims, Crushing Grip: Attacks with stony strength.

monsters.name: Moonlight Ronin
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A fallen warrior from the eastern lands who carries a cursed blade. Haunted by a blood-lust that never fades, they wander the misty borders of the world, seeking a worthy opponent to feed their eternal hunger. Abilities: Ghost Strike: Attacks with an ethereal blade, Blood Moon Dance: Increases speed in moonlight, Ethereal Evasion: Becomes briefly invisible.

monsters.name: Fey-Touched Blood-Seeker
monsters.description: Type: Undead. These elegant horrors possess a terrifying beauty that masks their predatory nature. They are often found in ancient groves, where they use their unnatural charm to lure travelers into the dark before draining their very will to live. Abilities: Alluring Aura: Charms nearby creatures, Charisma Drain: Steals the social presence of victims, Sunlight Vulnerability: Takes damage from bright light.

monsters.name: Soul-Drinking Spectre
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A powerful and subtle entity that exists on the fringes of life and death. It does not merely drink blood but consumes the spiritual essence of its victims, leaving behind only hollow husks of what they once were. Abilities: Life Tap: Drains health from a distance, Mist Transformation: Turns into a cloud of vapor, Grave Chill: Inflicts cold damage with its presence.

monsters.name: Cackling Shadow-Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Undead. These small, twisted undead are known for the unsettling, high-pitched laughter that echoes through the tunnels they haunt. They find a cruel joy in the fear of their prey, often playing with them before the final strike. Abilities: Maddening Guffaw: Causes uncontrollable laughter in victims, Agility Drain: Saps the coordination of prey, Vanishing Act: Blends perfectly into shadows.

monsters.name: Sturdy Vitality Thief
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Found in quiet hill communities, these unassuming horrors appear as weary travelers until they strike. They possess a heavy, draining touch that can leave even the strongest warrior gasping for air and unable to move. Abilities: Strength Sap: Reduces the physical power of victims, Magical Fatigue: Induces deep exhaustion through a spell, Unyielding Presence: Resistant to physical damage.

monsters.name: Eternal Domain Wanderer
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A unique strain of undead bound to a specific dark realm. They are driven by an insatiable curiosity and a dark hunger, wandering the mists forever in search of new experiences and fresh blood to sustain their cursed existence. Abilities: Mist Walker: Can navigate magical fogs easily, Taunting Presence: Distracts enemies with mockery, Persistent Hunger: Recovers health when feeding.

monsters.name: Pale Sanguivore
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A feral and ancient variant of the blood-drinker, these creatures have lost all semblance of their former humanity. They are gaunt, clawed monsters that hunt in the darkest corners of ruined cities, driven purely by instinct. Abilities: Blood Frenzy: Gains speed when blood is spilled, Razor Claws: Inflicts deep bleeding wounds, Beastial Leap: Can jump great distances to pounce.

monsters.name: Invisible Stalker-Wraith
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A stealthy predator from the eastern provinces that has mastered the art of vanishing into thin air. They are often used as assassins by dark lords, striking from the void before their victims even realize they are in danger. Abilities: Perfect Invisibility: Becomes unseen at will, Piercing Strike: Ignores physical armor, Ghostly Step: Moves silently across any surface.

monsters.name: Swamp-Dwelling Predator
monsters.description: Type: Undead. These bloated, water-logged undead lurk just beneath the surface of murky lagoons. They are as much at home in the water as they are on land, pulling unsuspecting victims into the depths to feed. Abilities: Aquatic Ambush: Gains a bonus when attacking from water, Drowning Touch: Forces water into the lungs of victims, Mud-Slick Skin: Hard to grapple or hold.

monsters.name: Ancient Noble Vampire
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Powerful and sophisticated lords of the night who rule from crumbling castles. They possess a terrifying array of magical abilities and can command the very weather and beasts of the field to do their bidding. Abilities: Command Minions: Summons wolves or bats, Weather Control: Creates localized storms or fog, Dominate Mind: Forces others to obey their will.

monsters.name: Sanguine Haze
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A floating cloud of crimson vapor that smells faintly of iron. It is a collective of blood-hungry spirits that envelops its prey, draining their life fluid through every pore in their skin. Abilities: Enveloping Mist: Grapples all creatures in its space, Blood Extraction: Drains blood without making a wound, Gaseous Form: Can pass through tiny cracks.

monsters.name: Vitality Parasite
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Unlike true undead, these beings are living creatures with a biological need for human blood. They often blend into high society, using their charm and wealth to hide their predatory nature from their unsuspecting peers. Abilities: Charming Persuasion: Easily influences social targets, Blood Thirst: Must feed regularly to stay strong, Quick Reflexes: Exceptional speed and agility.

monsters.name: Exiled Blood-Lord
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A conqueror from another world who found himself trapped in a land of mists. He has adapted his martial skills and dark magic to survive in this hostile environment, always looking for a way back to his home or a new kingdom to rule. Abilities: Martial Mastery: Expert with all melee weapons, Tactical Command: Enhances the fighting of his allies, Mist Resilience: Resistant to the effects of magical fogs.

monsters.name: Stench-Ridden Horror
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A bloated, grotesque entity from the lower planes that emits a nauseating gas. It is a creature of decay and filth, thriving in environments that would kill most living things. Abilities: Nauseating Cloud: Sickens nearby creatures, Filth Fever: Inflicts a rotting disease with a bite, Acidic Slime: Corrodes metal on contact.

monsters.name: Ethereal Fog-Ghoul
monsters.description: Type: Undead. These translucent horrors are formed from the souls of those who died lost in the mist. They are barely physical, appearing as flickering shapes that solidify only when they are about to strike. Abilities: Phasing Strike: Attacks pass through armor, Fog Camouflage: Nearly invisible in misty areas, Chilling Touch: Deals cold and necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Mountain Wraith-Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A vengeful spirit that haunts the high peaks and deep caverns. It is said to be the ghost of a miner or explorer who died in a cave-in, now seeking to drag others down into the dark with it. Abilities: Echoing Wail: Stuns victims with a piercing scream, Rock Slide: Can trigger small collapses of stone, Shadow Blend: Disappears in low light.

monsters.name: Swift-Pack Raider
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. These lean, predatory humanoids hunt in highly organized packs. They are faster and more feral than common orcs or goblins, using their superior speed to outmaneuver and overwhelm their prey. Abilities: Pack Tactics: Gains advantages when allies are near, Cunning Action: Can hide or disengage quickly, Primal Senses: Excellent tracking and night vision.

monsters.name: Cursed Screaming Head
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A horrific, disembodied head with bat-like wings and a face frozen in a permanent shriek. They flutter through the lower planes, looking for living victims to infect with their terrifying curse. Abilities: Paralyzing Shriek: Freezes victims in place with fear, Abyssal Kiss: Slowly transforms a victim into another head, Flight: High maneuverability in the air.

monsters.name: Prismatic Apex-Lurker
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. An ancient dragon with scales that shimmer like oil on water. It is a master of its domain, using its incredible size and ancient magic to protect its treasure and keep all intruders at bay. Abilities: Prismatic Breath: Fires a beam of shifting energy, Ancient Majesty: Terrifies lesser creatures, Smoke Veil: Creates a cloud of thick, obscuring smoke.

monsters.name: Dread Night-Flier
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. These bat-like fiends are the scouts of the abyss. They have leathery wings and sharp, needle-like teeth, and they are known for their ability to cast dark spells even while in flight. Abilities: Arcane Screech: Casts a random low-level spell, Echolocation: Can see perfectly in total darkness, Swoop Attack: Deals extra damage when diving.

monsters.name: Infernal Brimstone-Bat
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Large, flaming bats that dwell near volcanic vents in the hells. Their skin is scorched and cracked, and they leave a trail of burning embers wherever they fly. Abilities: Fiery Aura: Deals fire damage to nearby creatures, Magma Spit: Launches a glob of molten rock, Brimstone Scent: Tracks creatures by their heat.

monsters.name: Entropic Shadow-Well
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A localized rift in reality that appears as a swirling vortex of black energy. It is not truly alive in the traditional sense, but it hungers for the energy of all things, pulling everything towards its center to be consumed. Abilities: Gravitational Pull: Drags nearby creatures closer, Energy Siphon: Drains magical and physical power, Void Shield: Reflects incoming projectiles.

monsters.name: Fungal Hive-Dweller
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Small, plant-like humanoids with skin made of thick mold and caps of mushrooms growing from their heads. They live in quiet forest communities, communicating through spores and protecting their groves with primitive weapons. Abilities: Spore Cloud: Can blind or confuse attackers, Root Meld: Can hide perfectly among forest plants, Toxic Scratch: Claws deliver a mild poison.

monsters.name: Sprinting Raptor
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A small but incredibly deadly dinosaur that hunts in groups. They are covered in colorful feathers and possess a large, curved claw on each foot that they use to disembowel their prey with surgical precision. Abilities: Pounce: Can knock a target prone after a leap, Multi-Attack: Strikes rapidly with claws and teeth, Group Coordination: Gains bonuses when hunting in a pack.

monsters.name: Great Adhesive Slitherer
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A massive, worm-like creature that moves with surprising speed through cave systems. It secretes a powerful, glue-like substance that it can spray from its mouth to trap its prey before moving in for the kill. Abilities: Glue Spray: Restrains targets in a sticky mess, Constrict: Crushes prey with its powerful body, Cavern Camouflage: Hard to spot against cave walls.

monsters.name: Sunken River-Raider
monsters.description: Type: Undead. These undead pirates are the scourge of the inland waterways. They inhabit the rotted remains of sunken ships, emerging at night to raid passing vessels and drag sailors down to their watery graves. Abilities: Water-Breathing: Can survive indefinitely submerged, Harpoon Toss: Expert at using thrown piercing weapons, Rotting Chill: Touch inflicts cold damage and disease.

monsters.name: Vengeful Knight-Spectre
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A dark, armored spirit that relentlessly pursues those who wronged it in life. It cannot be bargained with or escaped, and it will stop at nothing until its target is destroyed. Abilities: Mark of Vengeance: Can always track its chosen target, Ghostly Armor: Resistant to non-magical weapons, Terrifying Gaze: Inflicts deep fear in the target.

monsters.name: Lord of the Verdant Realm
monsters.description: Type: Fey. A noble fey of immense power who rules over the oldest parts of the woods. He is tall and lithe, with skin like silver birch bark and hair of shifting autumn leaves, embodying the raw vitality of nature. Abilities: Nature's Command: Can control plants and animals, Fey Step: Short-range teleportation, Verdant Growth: Heals himself and allies with forest energy.

monsters.name: Leaf-Clad Reaver
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A large, humanoid figure composed entirely of living vines and razor-sharp leaves. They are the silent guardians of the jungle, moving through the undergrowth without a sound to eliminate any who would harm the greenery. Abilities: Serrated Strike: Attacks inflict bleeding, Camouflage: Becomes invisible while stationary in plants, Root Snare: Entangles enemies with vines.

monsters.name: The Abject Swarm
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A roiling mass of small, disgusting creatures like centipedes and spiders. They represent the discarded and the forgotten, overwhelming their prey by sheer numbers and the sheer revulsion they inspire. Abilities: Swarm Mastery: Can occupy another creature's space, Nauseating Presence: Nearby creatures may be sickened, Distraction: Hard to concentrate when covered in the swarm.

monsters.name: Chitinous Hive-Lord
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A humanoid who has allowed their body to be host to thousands of insects. They have patches of chitinous armor and multi-faceted eyes, ruling over swarms of vermin with a telepathic connection. Abilities: Insect Command: Can direct swarms of insects, Carapace Armor: High natural defense, Poisonous Sting: Can deliver a lethal toxin.

monsters.name: Planar Scuttler
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Small, elemental entities that take the form of various insects. Depending on their home plane, they may be made of fire, water, earth, or air, acting as the lowest tier of the elemental hierarchy. Abilities: Elemental Strike: Deals damage of its specific element, Planar Shift: Can briefly return to its home plane, Small Size: Hard to hit and can fit anywhere.

monsters.name: The Great Cosmic Parasite
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. An eldritch entity that exists between the stars. It is a mass of tentacles and mouths that feeds on the very fabric of reality, leaving behind \"dead zones\" where no life can exist. Abilities: Psychic Static: Disrupts the minds of nearby beings, Reality Warp: Can change the local environment, Infinite Consumption: Gains power for every creature it eats.

monsters.name: Winged Void-Crawler
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A massive, bat-like creature that sails through the vacuum of space. It has large, sail-like wings that catch the solar winds and a body built to withstand the extreme cold and pressure of the void. Abilities: Vacuum Adaptation: Can survive in space without air, Sonic Screech: Deals thunder damage in an atmosphere, Wing Buffet: Can knock back multiple enemies.

monsters.name: Dragon of Fate's Path
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A wise green dragon that is said to see the threads of destiny. Its scales are the color of deep jade, and its eyes hold the weight of centuries, often offering guidance to those it deems worthy—for a price. Abilities: Prophetic Vision: Can predict enemy movements, Fate's Breath: A gas that causes visions or sleep, Ancient Wisdom: Resistant to all mental influences.

monsters.name: Scarred Front-Line Soldier
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A warrior who has survived a hundred battles and has the scars to prove it. They are masters of multiple weapons and possess a tactical mind that allows them to lead smaller groups of soldiers with great efficiency. Abilities: Battle Hardened: Bonus to saving throws against fear, Weapon Versatility: Can use any weapon effectively, Tactical Strike: Deals extra damage when flanking.

monsters.name: Harbinger of the Dead
monsters.description: Type: Undead. An exceptionally powerful wight that serves as a general in the armies of the lich-kings. They are wreathed in a cold, black fire and carry weapons that can sever the soul from the body with a single stroke. Abilities: Soul Sever: Reduces the maximum HP of victims, Dread Aura: Weakens the resolve of nearby enemies, Summon Shadows: Can call forth lesser undead.

monsters.name: Psionic Sun-Daughter
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A rare group of women born with incredible mental powers in the harsh desert lands. They are often reclusive, living in hidden oases and using their telepathy to communicate and defend their territory. Abilities: Mind Blast: Deals psychic damage in a cone, Thought Shield: Protects against mental attacks, Telekinetic Grip: Can move objects and people with her mind.

monsters.name: Lurking Vine-Horror
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A mass of rotting vegetation that has taken on a roughly humanoid shape. They hide in the stagnant waters of swamps, looking like nothing more than a clump of vines until they lunge at a passing traveler. Abilities: Constrict: Grapples and crushes victims, Camouflage: Perfectly resembles swamp flora, Swamp Step: Ignores difficult terrain in wetlands.

monsters.name: The Endless Creeper
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A fast-growing vine that seems to have a mind of its own. It can cover a building in hours and is notoriously difficult to kill, as even a small fragment can quickly regrow into a full-sized plant. Abilities: Rapid Growth: Recovers from damage quickly, Thorns: Deals piercing damage to those who touch it, Entangle: Automatically grapples nearby enemies.

monsters.name: Thorny Root-Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A mobile plant composed of a roiling mass of thorny roots and vines. It moves with a strange, jerky motion, using its many appendages to pull itself across the ground and climb trees in search of prey. Abilities: Thicket Form: Becomes a dense pile of brush, Piercing Roots: Can strike from beneath the ground, Mobile Growth: Moves quickly for a plant.

monsters.name: Luminescent Spore-Fungus
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A large, purple mushroom that glows with an eerie light in the darkness of the underworld. It is highly territorial and will release a cloud of toxic spores at any creature that gets too close. Abilities: Poisonous Spores: Deals poison damage and confuses, Bioluminescence: Lights up the area around it, Static Defense: Hardens its cap to resist damage.

monsters.name: Serpent-Branched Tree
monsters.description: Type: Plant. A strange tree whose branches are actually living, venomous snakes. It stands perfectly still until an animal passes beneath it, at which point the \"branches\" strike with lightning speed. Abilities: Venomous Strike: Multiple bites that deal poison damage, Mimicry: Looks exactly like a normal tree, Constricting Branches: Can pull prey up into its canopy.

monsters.name: Magical Blight Pathogen
monsters.description: Type: Pathogen. A collection of various magical viruses created by a vengeful sorcerer. These diseases can cause anything from spontaneous combustion to the victim's skin turning into brittle crystal. Abilities: Virulent Spread: Easily infects those nearby, Varied Effects: Causes different symptoms in each host, Magical Resistance: Hard to cure with standard magic.

monsters.name: The Sorcerer's Curse
monsters.description: Type: Pathogen. An intelligent plague that was designed to punish an entire bloodline. It is extremely difficult to cure and seems to adapt its symptoms to the specific strengths and weaknesses of its host. Abilities: Targeted Infection: Gains bonuses against specific races, Adaptive Strain: Becomes resistant to spells used against it, Lingering Malaise: Causes long-term exhaustion.

monsters.name: Shadow-Warping Virus
monsters.description: Type: Pathogen. A psychic disease that infects the mind before the body. It causes the victim to see terrifying hallucinations and grants them strange mental powers, though at the cost of their sanity and eventually their life. Abilities: Hallucinatory Fever: Causes victims to attack allies, Psychic Overflow: Grants temporary psionic abilities to the host, Mental Decay: Reduces Intelligence and Wisdom over time.

monsters.name: Shifting Mask-Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A floating, translucent face that constantly changes its features. It haunts mirrors and dark hallways, stealing the identities of those it encounters and leaving them as faceless husks. Abilities: Identity Theft: Can take the appearance of a victim, Terrifying Shift: Changes into a horrific visage to stun, Ethereal Nature: Can move through walls.

monsters.name: Lizard-King Dragon
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. An ancient and wise dragon with a long, slender body covered in golden scales. It is more agile than its heavy-set cousins and is known for its deep understanding of philosophy and the natural laws of the universe. Abilities: Sage's Wisdom: Can cast high-level divination spells, Golden Breath: A cone of pure radiant energy, Agile Flight: Exceptional maneuverability.

monsters.name: Prism of Eternal Light
monsters.description: Type: Celestial. A manifestation of pure divine energy that looks like a floating, multi-faceted diamond. It radiates a warm, holy light that can heal the righteous and blind the wicked who dare to look upon it. Abilities: Radiance: Deals radiant damage to evil creatures, Healing Pulse: Restores health to nearby allies, Blinding Flash: Can permanently blind attackers.

monsters.name: Wide-Eyed Soul-Starver
monsters.description: Type: Undead. An emaciated undead creature with enormous, glowing eyes that seem to take up half its face. It feeds on the sight and memories of the living, literally drinking the light from their eyes. Abilities: Gaze of the Void: Stuns victims with its stare, Memory Drain: Reduces the experience or skills of a target, Shadow Stealth: Nearly impossible to see in low light.

monsters.name: Radiant Template Entity
monsters.description: Type: Template. A creature that has been infused with the pure, life-giving energy of the positive planes. They glow with a soft light and possess incredible vitality, often acting as protectors of life and light. Abilities: Regenerative Aura: Heals itself and nearby allies every turn, Radiant Strike: Attacks deal extra light damage, Life Surge: Can bring a creature back from the brink of death.

monsters.name: Subterranean Flesh-Carver
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. A multi-limbed horror that lives in deep tunnels. It has a clinical obsession with the bodies of other creatures, often capturing them to perform gruesome \"experiments\" with its surgical claws. Abilities: Surgical Precision: High chance of critical hits, Paralyzing Toxin: Claws can freeze a victim in place, Multi-Limbed Attack: Can strike many times in one turn.

monsters.name: The Scholar's Cap
monsters.description: Type: Symbiote. A strange, cloth-like creature that resembles a turban or hat. It bonds with a spellcaster, feeding on their life force in exchange for greatly enhancing their magical focus and power. Abilities: Arcane Link: Increases spell save DC and attack bonus, Life Bond: Drains a small amount of HP from the host daily, Shared Mind: Grants the host extra mental resistance.

monsters.name: Vengeful Dragon-Knight
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The undead remains of a once-noble knight who led an order of dragon riders. He is fueled by an eternal hatred for the dark lord who destroyed his people and now leads a ghost-legion in a never-ending war. Abilities: Draconic Strike: Melee attacks deal extra fire damage, Command the Dead: Directs other spirits in battle, Unstoppable Vengeance: Will reform if destroyed unless specific rites are performed.

monsters.name: Monkey-Bat Glider
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A small, furry creature with the body of a monkey and the wings of a bat. They live in the high canopy of jungles, using their prehensile tails to hang from branches and their wings to glide between trees. Abilities: Gliding Leap: Can travel long distances through the air, Prehensile Tail: Can hold objects or hang from trees, Nimble Dodge: High AC against ranged attacks.

monsters.name: Forest-Crowned Glider
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A specialized sub-species of the monkey-bat found in temperate forests. They have thicker fur and are known for their ability to blend into the autumn leaves, making them excellent scouts. Abilities: Woodland Camouflage: Stealth bonus in forests, Sharp Screech: Can alert others of danger, Quick Claws: Fast, repetitive melee attacks.

monsters.name: Mill-Pond Trickster
monsters.description: Type: Fey. A mischievous and often dangerous spirit that lives in deep rivers and beneath water wheels. They look like small, green-skinned old men with webbed hands and feet, and they love to play deadly pranks on travelers. Abilities: Water Control: Can create small whirlpools or waves, Illusion: Can make the water look shallow or safe, Slippery Skin: Very hard to grapple.

monsters.name: Energy-Draining Ooze
monsters.description: Type: Ooze. A translucent, black sludge that seems to absorb all light around it. It is a creature of the void that moves slowly but surely, dissolving everything it touches and draining the magical energy from items and people. Abilities: Magic Siphon: Can temporarily disable magical items, Dissolve: Deals heavy acid damage to organic matter, Void Body: Resistant to all non-magical damage.

monsters.name: Hollow-Mind Thrall
monsters.description: Type: Template. A creature whose mind has been completely wiped and replaced by a connection to the void. They are mindless puppets that follow the commands of their masters with terrifying efficiency and lack any sense of self-preservation. Abilities: Mindless Obedience: Immune to all mental effects, Psychic Link: Can communicate telepathically with its master, Fearless: Never retreats or flees.

monsters.name: Vortex of Pure Darkness
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A swirling mass of black smoke and shadows that has gained sentience. It is a manifestation of the utter nothingness that exists between planes, and its touch can freeze the soul and wither the body. Abilities: Life Extinguish: Can kill weakened creatures instantly, Absolute Dark: Creates an area of magical darkness, Intangible Form: Physical attacks pass through it.

monsters.name: The Master Explorer
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A world-renowned chronicler and traveler who has seen more of the multiverse than almost anyone alive. He is a fountain of knowledge about monsters and strange lands, though his penchant for exaggeration is well-known. Abilities: Encyclopedic Knowledge: Can identify any monster's weakness, Lucky Escape: Can avoid certain death through pure coincidence, Compelling Narrative: Can charm or distract with stories.

monsters.name: Sparking Imp
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A small, hopping fiend with skin that constantly crackles with electricity. They are pests of the lower planes, jumping onto larger creatures and delivering painful shocks just for the fun of it. Abilities: Static Jump: Deals lightning damage when leaping near someone, Chain Shock: Can hit multiple targets with a bolt, Evasive Hops: Very difficult to target with spells.

monsters.name: Sentient Tome-Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A category of magical entities that are bound to protect ancient archives. They can manifest as floating books, paper-thin warriors, or even the ink itself, rising up to defend the knowledge they guard. Abilities: Knowledge Shield: Uses information to predict and block attacks, Ink Spray: Blinds intruders with magical ink, Paper Cut: Inflicts many small, bleeding wounds.

monsters.name: Original Archive Construct
monsters.description: Type: Construct. The foundational guardians created by the first mages to protect their most basic research. They are sturdy and reliable, if unimaginative, using their stone-like bodies to crush any who would steal from the archives. Abilities: Crushing Blow: Heavy melee attack, Unyielding Guard: Cannot be moved or pushed, Arcane Pulse: Detects any magic in its vicinity.

monsters.name: Arcane Vault Sentry
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Sophisticated constructs designed to guard the most dangerous and secret magical items. They are equipped with multiple eyes to see through illusions and can cast various defensive spells to neutralize intruders. Abilities: True Sight: Sees through invisibility and illusions, Counterspell: Can negate incoming magic, Radiant Beam: Fires a focused beam of light.

monsters.name: Mythic Lore-Keeper
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Massive, multi-faced constructs that contain the collective history of a fallen empire. They act as both librarians and executioners, answering questions for the worthy and destroying those who lack the proper clearance. Abilities: Historical Insight: Can reveal a creature's past and weaknesses, Multi-Gaze: Can track and attack multiple targets at once, Stone Breath: A cone of petrifying gas.

monsters.name: Multi-Armed Lasher
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A horrific creature with a central body covered in dozens of long, prehensile tentacles. It uses these to whip and pull at its prey, often striking from several directions at once with incredible speed. Abilities: Flailing Lashes: Attacks all creatures within reach, Constricting Grip: Can grapple multiple targets, Ink Cloud: Creates a dark area to escape.

monsters.name: Bonded Soul-Thrall
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A victim of a vampire who was partially transformed to serve as a companion or mate. They possess some of the master's powers but are completely bound to their will, unable to survive if their master is destroyed. Abilities: Master's Link: Shares HP with its creator, Blood Bond: Gains power when the master feeds, Ethereal Jaunt: Can briefly follow its master into the ethereal plane.

monsters.name: Spectral Pack-Hound
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. Large, shadowy dogs that hunt in the service of planar shamans. They can move through solid objects and track their prey across different planes of existence, making them the ultimate trackers. Abilities: Planar Scent: Can track through portals and dimensions, Shadow Bite: Deals necrotic damage, Pack Howl: Buffs all nearby hounds.

monsters.name: Living Whirlwind
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A small, localized tornado that has gained a simple consciousness. They are chaotic and playful, spinning through the air and picking up anything that isn't bolted down, often causing accidental destruction. Abilities: Centrifugal Throw: Flings creatures it has picked up, Air Blast: A focused burst of wind that pushes back, Gale Shield: Deflects ranged attacks with high winds.

monsters.name: Storm-Cloud Dwellers
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Creatures that live within the heart of permanent storms. They are made of condensed vapor and lightning, and they descend to the surface only when a particularly powerful storm allows them to travel. Abilities: Lightning Discharge: Deals electrical damage to all nearby, Vapor Camouflage: Invisible inside clouds or fog, Thunderclap: Stuns enemies with a loud boom.

monsters.name: Temporal Web-Spinner
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A massive spider that builds its webs out of frozen moments in time. Those caught in its silk do not just stop moving; they stop aging and experiencing time altogether until the spider comes to feed. Abilities: Time Snare: Freezes a target in time (paralysis), Blink Strike: Attacks and then teleports a few seconds into the past, Haste Web: Can move incredibly fast on its own silk.

monsters.name: Desert Bone-Picker
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A large, ugly bird with a bald head and a massive, hooked beak. They are expert scavengers, able to survive on the driest carcasses and possess a keen eye for finding dying creatures from miles away. Abilities: Carrion Scent: Always knows the location of low-HP creatures, Desolate Flight: Can fly for days without water, Gut-Ripping Beak: Inflicts deep wounds.

monsters.name: Arid Hound-Scavenger
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A lean, hairless creature that looks like a cross between a dog and a vulture. They roam the scorched wastes in packs, using their powerful legs to outrun prey and their sharp beaks to finish it off. Abilities: Desert Runner: Ignores the effects of extreme heat, Pack Scavenge: Recovers HP when eating a corpse, Piercing Yip: Alerts the pack to a target.

monsters.name: Smoldering Ash-Drake
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A smaller cousin of the red dragon that lives in volcanic ash fields. Its scales are dull gray and constantly leak hot embers, and it can breathe a cloud of burning soot that chokes and blinds its enemies. Abilities: Ash Breath: Blinds and deals fire damage in a cone, Cinder Skin: Deals fire damage to those who touch it, Burrowing: Can move through hot ash and sand.

monsters.name: Glimmering Mote-Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Spirit. Tiny, playful spirits that appear as dancing balls of light. They are often found in peaceful gardens and are said to bring good luck to those they follow, though they can be quite mischievous if offended. Abilities: Guiding Light: Grants a bonus to an ally's next roll, Mote Dash: Moves instantly to any point in sight, Blind-Mote: A bright flash that temporarily blinds.

monsters.name: Mobile Bastion Wall
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A massive wall of stone and metal that has been given legs and a simple brain. They are used on the front lines of wars to provide instant cover for archers and mages, slowly marching forward into enemy fire. Abilities: Iron Cover: Provides total cover to those behind it, Stomp: Deals heavy damage to those in its path, Shield Bash: Pushes enemies back with a massive force.

monsters.name: Vertical Prowler
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A long, multi-legged creature that specializes in climbing vertical surfaces. It has sticky pads on its feet and a flexible spine, allowing it to move across ceilings and walls as easily as the floor. Abilities: Wall-Walk: Can move on any surface at full speed, Pounce from Above: Gains a bonus when attacking from a ceiling, Multi-Legged Grip: Very hard to knock prone.

monsters.name: Chameleon Desert-Nomad
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Peaceful nomads whose skin naturally changes color to match their environment. They are experts at surviving in the harshest deserts and are known for their deep spiritual connection to the land and its ancient secrets. Abilities: Skin Camouflage: Gains a massive bonus to stealth, Desert Survivalist: Expert at finding water and food, Patient Strike: Bonus damage when attacking from hidden.

monsters.name: Mimic Fortress-Tower
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A truly gargantuan mimic that has taken the form of a small watchtower or ruins. It waits for travelers to enter its \"doors\" before the walls turn into sticky flesh and the \"floor\" becomes a massive tongue. Abilities: False Entrance: Lures creatures inside, Internal Digestion: Deals acid damage to all inside, Crushing Collapse: Can \"fold\" itself to crush those within.

monsters.name: The Spirit-Advisor Oni
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. An intellectually superior oni with blue or green skin and refined robes. They prefer to use their words and spells to manipulate others, acting as the brains behind the brawn of more aggressive spirit-fiends. Abilities: Masterful Manipulation: Can force others to change their plans, Arcane Advisor: Grants bonuses to the spells of nearby allies, Infernal Logic: Deals psychic damage with a cutting remark.

monsters.name: Divine Battle-Herald
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A holy warrior who has mastered both the art of healing and the art of war. They lead from the front, their armor glowing with divine light and their voice inspiring their allies to feats of incredible bravery. Abilities: Divine Smite: Adds radiant damage to melee attacks, Healing Word: Heals an ally with a quick prayer, Inspiring Presence: Grants temporary HP to allies.

monsters.name: Trained War-Template
monsters.description: Type: Template. A beast that has been specifically bred and trained for the chaos of the battlefield. They are more aggressive, have higher endurance, and are completely unafraid of the noise and fire of large-scale combat. Abilities: War-Cry: Terrifies enemies when it charges, Relentless: Can keep fighting even at 0 HP for one turn, Armored Hide: Increases natural armor class.

monsters.name: Planar Gate-Sentinel
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Large, four-armed beasts that are bound to guard the portals between worlds. They have many eyes that can see into multiple dimensions at once, ensuring that nothing enters or leaves without permission. Abilities: Dimensional Anchor: Prevents teleportation nearby, Four-Armed Defense: Can parry multiple attacks at once, Planar Gaze: Sees through all forms of magical hiding.

monsters.name: Sentient Steel-Soldier
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A humanoid made of wood, stone, and metal, given life through a complex series of runes and souls. They were originally built for war but have since gained their own identity and a desire to find their place in the world. Abilities: Integrated Armor: Natural high defense, Tireless: Does not need to sleep or eat, Rune-Powered: Can briefly increase strength or speed.

monsters.name: Colossal Siege-Automaton
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A massive version of the steel-soldier, standing forty feet tall and built for tearing down castle walls. They are slow and lumbering, but a single swing of their massive arms can level a small building. Abilities: Siege Damage: Deals triple damage to structures, Ground Slam: Knocks all nearby creatures prone, Sweeping Strike: Hits every creature in a wide arc.

monsters.name: Heavy Armored Charger
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A large, powerful horse bred for its size and temperament. It is trained to carry a fully armored knight into the thickest part of a battle without flinching, using its own weight as a weapon. Abilities: Trample: Can move through and damage smaller creatures, Fearless Charge: Immune to fear when moving towards an enemy, Sturdy Build: Can carry great weights without slowing.

monsters.name: Executor of the Frozen Waste
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A dark knight who serves a cabal of warlocks in the cold northern lands. They are equipped with magical weapons and armor that pulse with a sickly purple light, enforcing the will of their masters with cold precision. Abilities: Chilling Strike: Melee attacks deal extra cold damage, Warlock's Shield: Absorbs a portion of incoming magic, Grim Resolve: Hard to influence or charm.

monsters.name: Emissary of the Fey-Court
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A mage who has made a pact with a noble of the wild realms. They are wreathed in illusions and glamour, able to charm their enemies into a peaceful slumber or vanish into a cloud of shimmering petals. Abilities: Fey Presence: Charms or frightens nearby enemies, Misty Escape: Teleports and turns invisible when hit, Beguiling Defenses: Reflects mental attacks back at the caster.

monsters.name: Acolyte of the Infernal Flame
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A dark spellcaster who has sold their soul for the power of the pits. They can call forth hellfire and summon minor demons to do their bidding, their skin often bearing the marks of their dark master. Abilities: Dark One's Blessing: Gains temporary HP when killing an enemy, Hurl Through Hell: Can briefly banish a creature to a hellish plane, Fiendish Vigor: Can cast false life at will.

monsters.name: Oracle of the Outer Void
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A mage whose mind has been touched by entities from beyond time and space. They speak in riddles and can warp the reality around them, calling forth tentacles from the void and striking with psychic force. Abilities: Awakened Mind: Can communicate telepathically with any creature, Entropic Ward: Can force an enemy to miss their attack, Create Thrall: Can permanently charm a incapacitated humanoid.

monsters.name: Legendary Battle-Commander
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A master of the battlefield who can turn the tide of a war with a single well-placed command. They are experts at reading terrain and enemy troop movements, always staying three steps ahead of their opponents. Abilities: Commanding Strike: Allows an ally to take an extra attack, Tactical Maneuver: Allows allies to move without provoking attacks, Rallying Cry: Heals and buffs all nearby allies.

monsters.name: Undead Eternal-Guard
monsters.description: Type: Undead. The skeleton of a great warrior who has been raised to serve forever. Unlike common skeletons, they retain their combat skill and a glimmer of their former intelligence, making them formidable opponents even in death. Abilities: Martial Memory: Uses the same attack bonus as when it was alive, Unyielding Bone: Resistant to piercing and slashing damage, Soul-Bound Weapon: Its weapon cannot be disarmed.

monsters.name: Clockwork Desert-Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Construct. A metallic entity from a plane of absolute law sent to protect the borders of the great deserts. They move with clicking precision and are tasked with ensuring that no drop of water is wasted and no border is crossed. Abilities: Lawful Strike: Deals extra damage to chaotic creatures, Water Search: Can detect any water within a mile, Inevitable Pursuit: Never stops tracking its target.

monsters.name: Experience-Gathering Wanderer
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A member of a sect that believes life is a series of experiences to be collected. They wander the planes, trying everything once and recording their findings in massive journals, often putting themselves in danger just for the \"thrill.\". Abilities: Jack of All Trades: Bonus to all skill checks, Quick Learner: Can mimic an ability it has seen recently, Plane-Walker: Knows the location of many hidden portals.

monsters.name: Spectral Watcher
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A ghostly figure that has been bound to a specific location or item. They are not necessarily evil, but they will defend their charge with a terrifying intensity, using their ethereal powers to drive off any intruders. Abilities: Ghostly Moan: Frightens all who hear it, Incorporeal Movement: Moves through objects and people, Ethereal Touch: Bypasses armor and shields.

monsters.name: Sacred Web-Protector
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Large, intelligent spiders that have been raised in temples or elven cities. They are trained to recognize specific smells and signals, acting as silent and deadly guards that trap intruders without killing them. Abilities: Non-Lethal Web: Traps enemies without harming them, Telepathic Link: Can alert its trainer to danger, Poison of Peace: Bite causes deep sleep instead of death.

monsters.name: Serpentine Water-Elemental
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A water elemental that has taken the form of a long, shimmering serpent. They inhabit sacred springs and clear lakes, moving with a fluid grace and attacking by constricting their enemies within their watery bodies. Abilities: Drowning Wrap: Grapples and begins to drown a target, Fluid Body: Can pass through very small spaces, Purifying Touch: Can heal or clean with its watery form.

monsters.name: Aquatic Sentinel
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A unique and powerful aquatic sentinel found in dangerous environments. Abilities: Aquatic Adaptation

monsters.name: Steam Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Lethal elemental spirits that inhabit the intersection of the planes of Fire and Water, manifesting as roiling currents of steaming, bioluminescent liquid. Abilities: Aquatic Adaptation, Fire Breath or Heat Aura, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Animated Blade
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Evil spirit animating a melee weapon. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Small Mustelid
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A unique and powerful small mustelid found in dangerous environments. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Colossal Weasel
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Giant Mustelid
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Sentient Silk
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Living, Memory. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Silk-Spitting Avian
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Monster Manual II (1983). Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Seaweed Eel
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Small, aggressive eels that hide within patches of thick seaweed and river-grass. Abilities: Aquatic Adaptation

monsters.name: Lion-Centaur
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Monstrous Manual (1993). Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Hunger Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Described are a sample Wendigo and the general Wendigo template. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Draconic Shifter
monsters.description: Type: Lycanthrope. A rare and powerful form of lycanthropy where an individual can assume the form of a dragon or a dragon-humanoid hybrid. Abilities: Draconic Breath

monsters.name: Raven Shifter
monsters.description: Type: Lycanthrope. Monstrous Compendium – Ravenloft Appendix (1991), Monstrous Manual (1993), Monstrous Compendium – Ravenloft Appendices I & II (1996), Ravenloft: Deniz. Abilities: Freezing Touch, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Shark Shifter
monsters.description: Type: Lycanthrope. Prior to 2E, weresharks were created by Dr. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Desert Hive-Flyer
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Enormous flying insects that make underground hives in the desert. Abilities: Flight

monsters.name: Leviathan
monsters.description: Type: Beast. The leviathan is based on the creature from Hebrew mythology. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Great Tooth-Whale
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Sea Giants
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Killer whale, Great whale and Narwhal. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Weeping Corpse
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Disturbing undead that manifest as emaciated corpses with their eyes sewn shut and their mouths perpetually open in a silent scream. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Thorny Tail-Beast
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Dragon no. Abilities: Draconic Breath

monsters.name: Thistle-Lash Plant
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Predatory subterranean plants that possess two long, whip-like fronds covered in sharp, serrated thorns. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Ice-Tooth Cat
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Creature Catalogue (1986), Creature Catalog (1993). Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Albino Gullet
monsters.description: Type: Ooze. Dead in Thay (2014). Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Frost-Bite Drake
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A subrace of dragons or dragon-like creatures from the frozen reaches of the north, characterized by their exceptionally sharp, ice-like teeth and claws. Abilities: Draconic Breath, Freezing Touch, Fearsome Natural Weapons

monsters.name: Spectral Climber
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Undead humanoids that are the spectral remnants of those who died from exposure in high mountain passes. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Sacrificial Effigy
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Colossal and terrifying constructs made of interwoven wood and dry vegetation, often used by dark druids or cults in sacrificial rituals. Abilities: Shadow Stealth

monsters.name: Crimson Seductress Spider
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Shapeshifting spiders which can assume the form of very attractive human females to lure victims into their lairs. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Halfling Cult Leader
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. The leader of the Nettlebee family of halflings in the Dessarin Valley, who has secret ties to the Cult of the Black Earth. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Marsh-Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Hurwaet, Swamp Wiggle, Salt Wiggle. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Barrow-Wight
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A unique and powerful barrow-wight found in dangerous environments. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness

monsters.name: Energy Drainers
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Thin humanoid undead that drains away energy levels on a hit. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Spectral Hunt
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Master of the Hunt, Hound of the Hunt. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Sunrise Wisp
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Radiant variants of the will-o'-wisp that inhabit the highest peaks at sunrise. Abilities: Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Abyssal Wisp
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Pressure-resistant variants of the will-o'-wisp found in the deepest parts of the ocean. Abilities: Aquatic Adaptation

monsters.name: Fog Wisp
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Subtle and elusive variants of the will-o'-wisp that inhabit misty forests and mountain trails. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Ocean Wisp
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Phosphorescent variants of the will-o'-wisp that drift on the surface of tropical oceans. Abilities: Aquatic Adaptation

monsters.name: Void Wisp
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Malevolent variants of the will-o'-wisp from the Plane of Shadow that emit a cold, violet light. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Freezing Touch, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Luring Wisp
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Highly clever creatures that lure foes to feed upon their life force. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Cunning Wisp
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Highly clever creatures that lure foes to feed upon their life force. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Spectral Lantern
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Type: Undead. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness

monsters.name: Marsh Lantern
monsters.description: Type: Fey. A unique and powerful marsh lantern found in dangerous environments. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness

monsters.name: Air Strider
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Strategic Review No. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Razor Wind Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Windrazor, windscythe. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Spectral Gale
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Monstrous Compendium Annual vol. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Flying Variant
monsters.description: Type: Template. Template to be added to any animal, giant, humanoid, monstrous humanoid, or vermin. Abilities: Flight

monsters.name: Draconic Flyer
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Monstrous Compendium Volume One (1989), Monstrous Manual (1993). Abilities: Flight

monsters.name: Aerial Soldier
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Creature Catalogue (1986). Abilities: Flight

monsters.name: Sky Knight
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Abilities: Flight, Petrifying Gaze or Earth Tremor

monsters.name: Grounded Marvel
monsters.description: Type: Abomination. True and Transformed. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Frost Wolf
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A unique and powerful frost wolf found in dangerous environments. Abilities: Freezing Touch

monsters.name: Arctic Wolf
monsters.description: Type: Beast. A unique and powerful arctic wolf found in dangerous environments. Abilities: Freezing Touch

monsters.name: Frost-Bound Dead
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Powerful undead that are born from the essence of elemental winter. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Freezing Touch, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Eternal Chill Wight
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Epic-level undead horrors that embody the absolute finality of death and cold. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Freezing Touch, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Occult Blade
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Witchknife captain. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Fen-Dwelling Reptilian
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Lizardfolk of the Witchlight Fens. Abilities: Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Chaos Raiders
monsters.description: Type: Abomination. Primary, Secondary, Tertiary, Space and Remote. Abilities: Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Ancient Treefolk
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Ancient and sentient plant creatures that resemble withered, humanoid-shaped trees. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Arcane Shadow
monsters.description: Type: Undead. the traveler's guide to All Things Magical (1996), Monstrous Compendium Annual vol. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Gray Pack-Hunter
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Animals that roam in packs | Type: Beast | Worgs are giant wolves inspired by the wargs in the works of J. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Trade Road Outlaws
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Bandits of the Trade Road. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Monstrous Wolf
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Dragon no. Abilities: Draconic Breath

monsters.name: Vaporous Wolf
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Spectral canines that inhabit misty forests and ancient ruins, possessing the ability to become partially incorporeal. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness

monsters.name: Lithic Wolf
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Dragon no. Abilities: Draconic Breath, Petrifying Gaze or Earth Tremor

monsters.name: Blood-Sucking Wolf
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Dragon no. Abilities: Draconic Breath

monsters.name: Wolf-Human Shifter
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A reverse of a werewolf, that transforms from a wolf to either a humanoid or a humanoid-wolf hybrid instead of from a human to a humanoid wolf. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Alpha Wolf-Shifter
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. An enhanced version of the common Wolfwere. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Fierce Glutton
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Normal and giant. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Sylvan Elemental
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. Template. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Timber Construct
monsters.description: Type: Construct. Abilities: Petrifying Gaze or Earth Tremor, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Forest Mischief
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Small and mischievous fey from the deep forests that resemble tiny, bark-covered humanoids with needle-sharp teeth. Abilities: Fire Breath or Heat Aura, Petrifying Gaze or Earth Tremor, Blinding Radiance, Fey Illusions, Fearsome Natural Weapons

monsters.name: Grove Guardian
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Monster Manual III (2004). Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Forest Sentinel
monsters.description: Type: Plant. Monster Manual III (2004). Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Tree-Kin
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Template. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Evil Great-Wolf
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A unique and powerful evil great-wolf found in dangerous environments. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Giant Burrower
monsters.description: Type: Beast. The "dread purple worm" attacks with both ends,[83]: 268  maw and stinger. Abilities: Venomous Strike

monsters.name: Swarm-Undead
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A horrific and exceptionally powerful form of undead resulting from a high-level spellcaster being consumed and then reanimated by a mass of worms or insects. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Horned Sand-Worm
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Dragon Annual no. Abilities: Draconic Breath

monsters.name: Tortured Remnant
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Wrackspawn are created/risen from the bodies of those fallen in battle, tortured prisoners, or others who endured extreme pain and bodily damage before death. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Spectral Terror
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A unique and powerful spectral terror found in dangerous environments. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness

monsters.name: Ancient Spirit King
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Exceptionally powerful and ancient wraiths that rule over spectral kingdoms and command legions of lesser undead. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Sun-Scorched Wraith
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Vengeful spirits of the world of Athas who have achieved a form of undead immortality tied to the silt or the sun. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Radiant Wraith
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Dungeon no. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Spectral Arachnid
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Ruins of Undermountain 2 (1994). Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Shadow Spirits
monsters.description: Type: Undead. High-class wights with more mobility. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Ethereal Serpent
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Terrifying undead monstrosities that resemble massive, tattered serpents made of solidified shadow. Abilities: Life Drain or Etherealness, Shadow Stealth, Blinding Radiance

monsters.name: Spine-Backed Burrower
monsters.description: Type: Beast. Small, aggressive mammals from the Savage Coast of Mystara that resemble a cross between a mole and a porcupine. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Desert Hazard
monsters.description: Type: Environmental. A category placeholder for creatures, environmental hazards, and unique entities introduced in the 'Sandstorm' supplement, which detailed the perils and wonders of desert environments. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Frozen Peril
monsters.description: Type: Environmental. A category placeholder for monsters, cold-based spells, and hazards featured in the 'Frostburn' supplement, exploring the frozen wastes and arctic realms. Abilities: Freezing Touch

monsters.name: Nautical Menace
monsters.description: Type: Environmental. A category placeholder for aquatic creatures, naval hazards, and oceanic lore introduced in the 'Stormwrack' supplement, detailing the secrets of the seas and oceans. Abilities: Aquatic Adaptation

monsters.name: Otherworldly Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A category placeholder for the diverse and often alien monsters introduced in the 2003 edition of the Fiend Folio, expanding the multiverse with unique fiends and aberrations. Abilities: Fire Breath or Heat Aura, Petrifying Gaze or Earth Tremor, Blinding Radiance, Fearsome Natural Weapons

monsters.name: Young Drake
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. The young and agile offspring of various dragon species. Abilities: Draconic Breath

monsters.name: Spark-Fey
monsters.description: Type: Fey. Tiny, bioluminescent fey that inhabit the most remote and magical corners of the Inner Planes. Abilities: Blinding Radiance, Fey Illusions

monsters.name: Tentacled Trap-Beast
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Bizarre subterranean aberrations that resemble a cluster of long, muscular tentacles ending in sharp claws and a single, central eye. Abilities: Grasping Tendrils, Fearsome Natural Weapons

monsters.name: Library Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Reclusive spirits from oriental folklore that inhabit old libraries and archives. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Fate-Weaver Spirit
monsters.description: Type: Undead. Normal and greater. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Tentacled Worm-Beast
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. Large, worm-like aberrations from the Underdark that possess a mass of writhing, sticky tentacles surrounding their tooth-filled mouths. Abilities: Grasping Tendrils, Shadow Stealth

monsters.name: Void-Worm
monsters.description: Type: Aberration. The Gates of Firestorm Peak (1996), Speaker in Dreams (2001), Monster Manual II (2002). Abilities: Fire Breath or Heat Aura

monsters.name: Poison-Tail Drake
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. Type: Dragon. Abilities: Draconic Breath

monsters.name: Sky-Stingers
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. Smaller relatives of dragons with poisonous sting in tail. Abilities: Venomous Strike, Draconic Breath

monsters.name: Ancient Castle Entity
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Abilities: Natural Weapons, Acute Senses

monsters.name: Luminous Spark
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A cluster of glowing golden orbs and beams of pure light energy. They are manifestations of vitality and brilliance. Abilities: Emits blinding light, heals nearby allies with positive energy, and can fire concentrated beams of radiance.

monsters.name: Dual Energy Essence
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A complex being composed of alternating pulses of light and shadow, representing the balance between opposing energy planes. Abilities: Can shift between radiant and necrotic forms, absorbing energy of one type to empower attacks of the other.

monsters.name: Ambitious Spellweaver
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A half-elven sorceress with a charming demeanor and a fierce ambition, often found exploring dangerous tropical regions. Abilities: Master of innate arcane magic, specializing in illusions and elemental manipulation to navigate wild environments.

monsters.name: Iridescent Sting-Drake
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A massive dragon with scales that shimmer with a thousand colors, known for its deadly tail stinger and smoke-filled lair. Abilities: Exhales a cloud of blinding iridescent smoke and delivers a potent paralytic venom through its tail.

monsters.name: Ancient Scale-Lurker
monsters.description: Type: Dragon. A powerful and ancient reptile with scales as hard as diamond, preferring to dwell in volcanic caverns. Abilities: Can manipulate the heat of its surroundings and possesses a roar that can shatter stone.

monsters.name: Void Tendril
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A mass of light-absorbing black orbs and shadowy tendrils that drain the very essence of life from their surroundings. Abilities: Projects an aura of absolute darkness, drains strength through touch, and can become nearly invisible in low light.

monsters.name: Psionic Wanderer
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A lithe and agile humanoid with innate psionic talents, often originating from scorched desert landscapes. Abilities: Uses mental focus to enhance physical speed and can project telepathic shocks to disorient foes.

monsters.name: Multi-Limbed Hell-Fiend
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A terrifying fusion of humanoid and insectoid features with multiple sharp limbs, hailing from the deepest infernal pits. Abilities: Climbs vertical surfaces with ease, attacks multiple times in a single flurry, and breathes a cone of sulfurous fire.

monsters.name: Silk-Skinned Shade
monsters.description: Type: Outsider. Gaunt humanoids with skin like shifting grey silk, these reclusive beings are native to the realm of shadows. Abilities: Can step through shadows to teleport short distances and exerts a chilling influence that slows the heartbeat of nearby mortals.

monsters.name: Infernal Claw-Stalker
monsters.description: Type: Fiend. A multi-armed demonic hunter that prowls brimstone-choked environments, seeking prey to drag back to its fiery home. Abilities: Expert at grappling with its four arms and can ignite its own claws to deal extra fire damage.

monsters.name: Void-Sailing Insectoid
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. Intelligent, six-limbed insectoid creatures adapted for life among the stars and magical vessels. Abilities: Expert at surgical modifications, uses specialized tools as weapons, and can leap great distances in low gravity.

monsters.name: Triple-Gazed Earth-Eater
monsters.description: Type: Elemental. A stout, three-legged elemental with a mouth on top of its head and three eyes positioned around its body, feeding on precious minerals. Abilities: Burrows through solid rock effortlessly and can sense vibrations of hidden gems and ores from miles away.

monsters.name: Azure Cave-Dweller
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Small, blue-skinned humanoids with bright orange eyes, often found in large, chaotic tribes within subterranean caverns. Abilities: Highly coordinated in group combat and can call upon minor curses to hinder their enemies.

monsters.name: Azure Cave-Raiders
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A group of blue-skinned cave dwellers that specialize in hit-and-run tactics and ambushing travelers. Abilities: Exceptional at setting traps and using their small size to navigate cramped tunnels quickly.

monsters.name: Rhino-Drake
monsters.description: Type: Monstrosity. A massive, armored reptile resembling a cross between a dragon and a rhinoceros, possessing a single formidable horn. Abilities: Charges with devastating force and has hide thick enough to deflect most mundane projectiles.

monsters.name: Dragon-Bound Warrior
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Formidable warriors from ancient lands who have dedicated their lives to the service or study of draconic entities. Abilities: Wields weapons infused with elemental energy and possesses a high resistance to fear.

monsters.name: Mountain Yak-Kin
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Large, isolationist humanoids with the upper bodies of yaks and powerful human-like legs, dwelling in high mountain passes. Abilities: Immovable when planted, possesses incredible physical strength, and can endure extreme cold.

monsters.name: Highland Beast-Lord
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. A powerful leader among the yak-kin, known for their tactical brilliance and command over the harsh mountain elements. Abilities: Can summon localized blizzards and inspires nearby allies to fight with relentless fury.

monsters.name: Woolly Shaman
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. The spiritual heart of a mountain tribe, this elder yak-kin commands the powers of stone and sky. Abilities: Heals wounds through ritual chanting and can turn the ground into treacherous difficult terrain.

monsters.name: Iron-Horn Sentinel
monsters.description: Type: Humanoid. Elite protectors of the mountain passes, clad in heavy stone armor and wielding massive polearms. Abilities: Blocks incoming attacks for allies and can execute a sweeping strike that knocks multiple foes prone.

monsters.name: Multi-Headed Spirit-Knight
monsters.description: Type: Undead. A skeletal warrior from the spirit realms, possessing multiple heads that whisper in unison and wielding ancient, cursed blades. Abilities: Cannot be surprised due to its multiple fields of vision and deals necrotic damage with every strike.

monsters.name: Hyena-Lord of Chaos
